Equation (11-1) clearly reveals the nested hierarchy of constraints across the three metrics: when $S=K=1$ and the speaker label is correct, all three reduce identically to standard single-speaker WER; in multi-speaker scenarios, ORC-WER enjoys the largest feasible reassignment space ($K^U$ utterance-level assignments), cpWER tightens reassignment to $M!$ session-wide slot permutations, and sa-WER collapses reassignment freedom entirely to $1$ fixed identity mapping, yielding the universal ordering $\text{ORC-WER} \le \text{cpWER} \le \text{sa-WER}$ on the exact same transcribed words (whenever real-name labels are produced via a one-to-one global binding to output slots; for `cpWER` vs. `ORC-WER` under streaming CSS stitching see [Chapter 8, §8.6](08_speech-separation.md#sec-8-6), and for `cpWER`'s double-penalty mechanics and `tcpWER` across cascaded vs. joint meeting architectures see [Chapter 15, §15.7](15_target-extraction-diarization.md#sec-15-7)).

**Takeaway for system selection**: On the exact same four recognized words, the three protocols report **ORC-WER = 0%**, **cpWER = 50%**, and **sa-WER = 100%**. This contrast clearly separates the physical roles of the three metrics: an ORC-WER of zero proves only that no spoken word was missed, never that an output stream stayed locked onto one person; cpWER rising to 50% cleanly exposes the anonymous cross-block slot swap in Segment 2; and sa-WER reaching 100% shows that even when a voiceprint module tracks each vocal timbre across slots, a misbound enrollment profile will misattribute every line of meeting minutes where personal accountability matters.

Unconstrained edit distance without timing introduces a second pitfall: in tens-of-minutes-long meeting recordings where high-frequency backchannels such as "okay," "right," and "yes" recur constantly, standard dynamic programming will pair a reference word missed at $1\ \mathrm{s}$ with an identical word spuriously inserted at $10\ \mathrm{min}$ for "zero error" (see [E11-17](#e11-17)). locator_hits_first5.text: **端到端模数（A/D）增益分配与动态范围预算。** 硬件选型必须把麦克风本底噪声（EIN）、模拟前置增益（PGA）、ADC 有效位数（ENOB）与近场打断过载点（AOP）放到同一把声压标尺上核算。商用高信噪比 MEMS 麦克风的等效输入噪声通常为 $\mathrm{EIN}\approx 26\text{～}30\ \mathrm{dB(A)\ SPL}$（对应 $94\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ 下 $64\text{～}68\ \mathrm{dB}$ SNR），而近场拍手或大音量外放打断（barge-in）要求 $\mathrm{AOP}\approx 120\text{～}130\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ 不削波，这两类数据的计权与带宽不同，须先统一测量口径再求可用动态跨度。另一方面，ADC 的有效位数 $\mathrm{ENOB}$ 由满幅正弦 SINAD 定义，SINAD 同时包含噪声与失真：
$$\mathrm{SINAD}\approx 6.02\,\mathrm{ENOB}+1.76\ \mathrm{dB}.$$

以构造的 $\mathrm{ENOB}=14.5$ 为例，上式给出 $89.1\ \mathrm{dB}$ SINAD，而非实测纯噪声动态范围。仅在失真可忽略、计权与带宽一致时，把满幅对应到 $128\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ 才能得到约 $38.9\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ 的等效噪声底示例。麦克风 A 计权 EIN 不能直接与未计权 ADC 数字相减；选择 PGA、满幅余量及 24 位接口前，应分别取得同口径 ADC 噪声和 THD 数据，名义位数本身不证明噪声性能。

**End-to-end A/D gain-staging and dynamic-range budget.** Hardware selection must place microphone Equivalent Input Noise (EIN), analog Programmable Gain Amplifier (PGA) gain, ADC Effective Number of Bits (ENOB), and near-field barge-in AOP on one unified SPL ruler. Commercial high-SNR MEMS microphones achieve $\mathrm{EIN}\approx 26\text{--}30\ \mathrm{dB(A)\ SPL}$ ($64\text{--}68\ \mathrm{dB}$ SNR at $94\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$), while near-field clapping or high-volume playback barge-in requires $\mathrm{AOP}\approx 120\text{--}130\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ headroom; weighting and bandwidth must be matched before deriving a usable acoustic dynamic span. Meanwhile, ENOB is defined from the full-scale sine SINAD, including both noise and distortion:
$$\mathrm{SINAD}\approx 6.02\,\mathrm{ENOB}+1.76\ \mathrm{dB}.$$

For a constructed ADC with $\mathrm{ENOB}=14.5$, the relation gives $89.1\ \mathrm{dB}$ SINAD, not a measured noise-only floor. If distortion is negligible and all noise levels use the same bandwidth and weighting, mapping full scale to $128\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ would imply an equivalent floor near $38.9\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$. An A-weighted microphone EIN cannot be subtracted directly from an unweighted ADC figure. Measure ADC noise and THD separately under matched conditions before selecting PGA gain, headroom, or a nominal 24-bit interface; nominal bit depth alone establishes none of these performance levels.

**超声工业检漏与局部放电声学相机（20～100 kHz）**：在压缩空气管道微漏、真空密封失效与高压开关柜局部放电（Partial Discharge）巡检中，待测故障在可听声段常被车间强机械背景噪声彻底掩蔽，却在 $20\text{～}100\,\mathrm{kHz}$ 超声频段产生显著的湍流喷射声或电晕脉冲。手持式工业超声声学相机依托宽带超声 MEMS 麦克风（典型采样率 $192\text{～}256\,\mathrm{kHz}$），在紧凑手持孔径 $D \approx 15\text{～}20\,\mathrm{cm}$ 下借助极短波长大幅提升空间分辨力：以 $f = 40\,\mathrm{kHz}$（$c = 343\,\mathrm{m/s}$，波长 $\lambda \approx 8.6\,\mathrm{mm}$）与 $D = 0.18\,\mathrm{m}$ 为例，同一填充圆盘公式在 $z=1.0\,\mathrm{m}$ 给出约 $5.8\,\mathrm{cm}$ 的尺度（$4\,\mathrm{kHz}$ 时约 $58\,\mathrm{cm}$）。把 $z=0.15\,\mathrm{m}$ 代入仍会算得 $8.7\,\mathrm{mm}$，但此时距径比已不满足近轴条件，不能据此外推实际亚厘米分辨；需使用真实阵元位置和球面传播模型计算 PSF。超声成像须同步处理两项高频特有的物理边界：其一，**大气声吸收衰减 $\alpha_{\mathrm{air}}(f)$**——空气黏滞与热传导引起的经典吸收随 $f^2$ 急剧攀升（叠加 $\mathrm{O}_2/\mathrm{N}_2$ 分子弛豫，常温常湿下 $40\text{～}100\,\mathrm{kHz}$ 衰减可达约 $1\text{～}3\,\mathrm{dB/m}$ 以上，参见 ISO 9613-1），因此数米外定量换算泄漏率或声源级时须在式(12-2)的 $1/r_{mj}$ 球面扩散项之外补乘指数吸收项 $10^{-\alpha_{\mathrm{air}}(f) r_{mj}/20}$（$\alpha_{\mathrm{air}}$ 单位为 dB/m；若用自然指数，须先乘 $\ln(10)/20$ 转为 Np/m）；其二，**亚厘米波长下的空间混叠抑制**——由于 $40\text{～}100\,\mathrm{kHz}$ 半波长仅 $1.7\text{～}4.3\,\mathrm{mm}$、已小于物理 MEMS 封装尺寸，规则网格必然激发与主瓣等高的周期栅瓣，故手持超声相机普遍采用 $64\text{～}128$ 阵元的非规则多臂对数螺旋或黄金角螺旋拓扑打散周期栅瓣，并配合宽带多频点合成平均（真实源峰随频率固定、混叠旁瓣随频率游移）进一步压低伪像。

NASA field-array deployment procedures distinguish laboratory bench absolute calibration before/after campaigns from in-situ reference-source drift monitoring: field check-sources are subject to loudspeaker directivity, atmospheric absorption, temperature/humidity/wind shifts, and transducer drift, so relative in-situ checks supplement rather than replace full-channel bench calibration ([Humphreys et al. 2017, §§II–III](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20170006081/downloads/20170006081.pdf)).

**Ultrasonic industrial leak and partial-discharge acoustic cameras (20–100 kHz)**: In compressed-air pipeline leak inspection, vacuum-seal testing, and high-voltage switchgear partial-discharge diagnostics, target faults are often buried beneath loud audible plant noise yet radiate strong turbulent jet hiss or corona impulses across $20\text{–}100\,\mathrm{kHz}$. Handheld industrial ultrasonic cameras leverage wideband ultrasonic MEMS microphones (typically sampled at $192\text{–}256\,\mathrm{kHz}$) so a compact aperture of $D \approx 15\text{–}20\,\mathrm{cm}$ attains high spatial precision via short wavelengths: at $f = 40\,\mathrm{kHz}$ ($c = 343\,\mathrm{m/s},\ \lambda \approx 8.6\,\mathrm{mm}$) with $D = 0.18\,\mathrm{m}$, the same filled-disk formula gives a scale of about $5.8\,\mathrm{cm}$ at $z=1.0\,\mathrm{m}$ (about $58\,\mathrm{cm}$ at $4\,\mathrm{kHz}$). Substitution at $z=0.15\,\mathrm{m}$ gives $8.7\,\mathrm{mm}$ arithmetically, but this standoff/aperture ratio violates the paraxial condition: actual sub-centimeter resolution must be assessed from the sensor layout and a spherical-wave PSF. Two high-frequency physical constraints govern ultrasonic imaging: first, **atmospheric absorption $\alpha_{\mathrm{air}}(f)$**—classical viscothermal attenuation scales with $f^2$ (combined with $\mathrm{O}_2/\mathrm{N}_2$ molecular relaxation per ISO 9613-1, reaching roughly $1\text{–}3\,\mathrm{dB/m}$ or higher across $40\text{–}100\,\mathrm{kHz}$ at room humidity), so quantitative leak-rate or source-level estimation over multi-meter standoffs must multiply the $1/r_{mj}$ spreading factor in Eq. (12-2) by $10^{-\alpha_{\mathrm{air}}(f) r_{mj}/20}$ with $\alpha_{\mathrm{air}}$ in dB/m (or convert to nepers/m before using an exponential); second, **spatial-aliasing mitigation**—because half-wavelengths ($1.7\text{–}4.3\,\mathrm{mm}$ across $40\text{–}100\,\mathrm{kHz}$) fall below physical MEMS package footprints, regular grids inevitably excite full-height grating lobes, so handheld ultrasonic cameras pair dense $64\text{–}128$-element irregular multi-arm or golden-angle spirals (dispersing grating lobes into a low diffuse floor) with wideband multi-frequency averaging where true source peaks stay stationary while frequency-dependent sidelobes smear out.

locator_hits_first5.text: 如果节点不在时域重建广播波形，而是直接把 WOLA 分析帧的**频域单边复数谱**打包发给邻居，比特率会变小还是变大？我们来列公式精算：$N$ 点实信号 FFT 共有 $\lfloor N/2 \rfloor + 1$ 个非负频点（含直流点 $k = 0$；偶数 $N$ 时还含独立的 Nyquist 点 $k = N/2$）。设帧移跳长为 $H$（每秒产生 $f_s / H$ 帧），每节点发送 $Q$ 路压缩谱，每个复数采用 `complex64`（实部、虚部各占 $32$ 位，共 $64$ 位），则频域广播流的净载荷速率为：

第一步先将远端环形输入缓冲区的读指针前移 $+m_\ell$ 个样本（从索引 $\ell H + m_\ell$ 开始取帧；$\varepsilon > 0$ 时每当 $m_\ell$ 加 $1$ 便跳过 $1$ 个输入样本，$\varepsilon < 0$ 时每当 $m_\ell$ 减 $1$ 便回退 $1$ 个样本），由此得到的滑移帧频谱 $X_q^{(\mathrm{slip})}[k,\ell]$ 仅保留幅值不超过半个样本的滞后 $+\Delta_\ell$（对应残余相位 $e^{-\mathrm{j}\frac{2\pi k}{N}\Delta_\ell}$）；第二步直接在正频点 $k = 0, \dots, N/2$ 上乘以**正号**线性相位旋转因子 $\exp\!\big(+\mathrm{j}\frac{2\pi k}{N}\Delta_\ell\big)$（全长 $N$ 点复谱的负频点取共轭对称，奈奎斯特频点取实部）在带限及帧内时差近似恒定的条件下补偿残余相位——若误用负号，分数滞后非但不会被消去，反而会加倍。需要注意这一频域近似的**帧内漂移有效界**：用单一相位斜坡替代连续重采样默认整帧 $N$ 个采样点内的时钟偏移近似恒定，仅在帧内总漂移满足 $|\varepsilon| N \ll 1$ 时成立（例如 $\varepsilon = 100\,\mathrm{ppm}$、$N = 512$ 时 $|\varepsilon| N = 0.0512 \ll 1$，即使在奈奎斯特频率处窗边缘相位偏差也低于 $4.6^\circ$）；若遭遇剧烈频偏或超长窗导致 $|\varepsilon| N \gtrsim 0.5$，帧内时间伸缩将引发相邻频点间的谱泄漏涂抹，无法再靠逐频点相位乘法消除，必须退回时域加窗 sinc 或 Farrow 多项式重采样（关于 DWACD 启发的双窗互谱斜率控制与活动门控的定量验证见 [E13-21](#e13-21)）。
此处还要求信号严格带限于 Nyquist 以下。对实序列 $x[n]=(-1)^n$，旋转 Nyquist 频点后取实部会把幅度乘以 $\cos(\pi\Delta)$：$\Delta=1/4$ 时剩 $1/\sqrt2$，$1/2$ 时为零，并非保幅的理想分数延迟。帧内漂移很小也不能消除这个端点限制。

核对配套代码的 `resource_control` 字段时需留意参数设置差异：代码另取四分之一窗帧移 $H = 128$，帧率比题干的 $H = 256$ 高一倍，故单路复谱流速率为 $2056000\,\mathrm{bit/s}$（两节点合计 $4112000\,\mathrm{bit/s}$）。此外可验证奇数 FFT 长度边界：保持 $H = 256$、将 $N$ 改为奇数 $511$ 时，非负频点为 $k = 0, \ldots, 255$ 共 $256$ 个，单路速率降为 $(16000 / 256) \times 256 \times 64$，即 $1024000\,\mathrm{bit/s}$，且最高频点 $\frac{255}{511}f_s < f_s / 2$ 含有非零虚部，不能当作实数 Nyquist 点省掉虚部。

What if a node transmits WOLA **one-sided complex spectra** instead of reconstructing a time-domain broadcast stream? An $N$-point real FFT has $\lfloor N/2 \rfloor + 1$ non-negative bins (including DC $k=0$ and even-$N$ Nyquist $k=N/2$). At hop $H$ ($f_s / H$ frames/s), $Q$ streams, and `complex64` ($32$-bit real + $32$-bit imag $= 64$ bits/bin), net spectral bitrate is:

Step 1 advances node $q$'s circular input-buffer read pointer by $+m_\ell$ samples (reading frame $\ell$ starting at $\ell H + m_\ell$: skipping $1$ input sample whenever $m_\ell$ increments by $+1$ for $\varepsilon > 0$, or stepping back $1$ sample whenever $m_\ell$ decrements for $\varepsilon < 0$), leaving the slipped spectrum $X_q^{(\mathrm{slip})}[k,\ell]$ with only the residual lag $+\Delta_\ell \in [-0.5, 0.5]$ samples (phase $e^{-\mathrm{j}\frac{2\pi k}{N}\Delta_\ell}$). Step 2 multiplies positive-frequency bins $k = 0, \dots, N/2$ by the **positive-sign** linear phase factor $\exp\!\big(+\mathrm{j}\frac{2\pi k}{N}\Delta_\ell\big)$ (with conjugate symmetry on negative bins $k > N/2$ and real Nyquist bin $k = N/2$) to compensate that residual phase under bandlimited, approximately frame-constant delay—flipping this sign would double the residual drift instead of cancelling it. Note the **intra-frame approximation bound**: modeling continuous resampling as a single frame-wide delay $\Delta_\ell$ holds accurately only when intra-frame drift satisfies $|\varepsilon| N \ll 1$ (e.g., at $\varepsilon = 100\,\mathrm{ppm}$ and $N = 512$, $|\varepsilon| N = 0.0512 \ll 1$, holding window-edge phase error under $4.6^\circ$ even at Nyquist); under severe SRO or very long windows with $|\varepsilon| N \gtrsim 0.5$, intra-frame time stretching smears energy across adjacent DFT bins beyond what bin-wise phase multiplication can repair, requiring time-domain windowed-sinc or Farrow resampling instead (see [E13-21](#e13-21) for quantitative verification of the DWACD-inspired two-window control and activity gating).

A further condition is strict band limitation below Nyquist. For real $x[n]=(-1)^n$, rotating the Nyquist bin and taking its real part scales it by $\cos(\pi\Delta)$, giving $1/\sqrt2$ at $\Delta=1/4$ and zero at $1/2$; this is not a lossless fractional delay. Small intra-frame drift does not remove this endpoint limitation.

When auditing the companion code's `resource_control` field, note it uses quarter-window hop $H = 128$, doubling frame rate and raising per-node spectral bitrate to $2056000\,\mathrm{bit/s}$ ($4112000\,\mathrm{bit/s}$ across two nodes). Also verify the odd-FFT edge case: at $H = 256$ and odd $N = 511$, there are $256$ non-negative bins ($k = 0, \ldots, 255$), yielding $(16000 / 256) \times 256 \times 64 = 1024000\,\mathrm{bit/s}$, and top bin $\frac{255}{511}f_s < f_s / 2$ has a nonzero imaginary part that cannot be omitted as a real Nyquist bin.

3. **自监督语音基座（如 WavLM）**：[Chen 等（IEEE JSTSP 2022）](https://doi.org/10.1109/JSTSP.2022.3188113) 在预训练阶段主动构造多说话人重叠与噪声混叠任务并预测掩码隐表征，其多层加权特征在多人混叠与低信噪比注册条件下较传统梅尔频谱前端具有明显抗干扰优势。

**面向实时会议的流式在线日志（Streaming Diarization）与 2023–2025 年新进展**：上述基础 EEND-EDA 需要先读完数分钟整段录音再统一解码吸引子，无法直接满足实时字幕的低延迟要求。工程上把神经多标签日志推向流式分块运行主要依赖两条经典路径：一是**说话人追踪缓存（Speaker-Tracing Buffer，STB）**（[Xue 等，IEEE SLT 2021](https://doi.org/10.1109/SLT48900.2021.9383523)），在每个 $1$～$2\ \mathrm{s}$ 流式新块前拼接历史上已确立身份的代表性帧缓存，让自注意力在同一前向传播中锁定跨块一致的槽位编号，消除分块间的排列跳变；二是**局部—全局吸引子架构（EEND-GLA）**（[Horiguchi 等，IEEE/ACM TASLP 2023](https://doi.org/10.1109/TASLP.2022.3233237)），在短分块内用局部吸引子完成低延迟重叠检测，同时通过无监督在线全局聚类将各块局部吸引子增量归并到不设上限的全局说话人库中。近两年多标签日志进一步向幂集分类与到达序排序演进：Plaquet 与 Bredin（[Interspeech 2023](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2023-205)）在 `pyannote.audio` 3.x 中引入**幂集多类交叉熵（Powerset）日志**，将单讲与双/三人重叠组合直接编码为互斥类别，摆脱敏感的逐类二值门限调参；**Sortformer**（[Park 等，ICML 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.06656)）以按首次发言时刻排序的 Sort Loss 替代置换不变训练，其后续 **Streaming Sortformer**（[Medennikov、Park 等，Interspeech 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.18446)）进一步配以到达序说话人缓存（Arrival-Order Speaker Cache，AOSC）支持流式在线日志；**DiariZen**（[Han 等，ICASSP 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.09408)）则将WavLM 多层加权表征、Conformer 幂集局部分割与带 cannot-link 约束的凝聚层次聚类（AHC）有机结合，在多个远场会议基准上刷新了混合日志精度。

(IEEE JSTSP 2022)](https://doi.org/10.1109/JSTSP.2022.3188113) inject multi-speaker overlap and noise-mixing tasks during masked-prediction pretraining; weighted multi-layer WavLM features exhibit strong noise and overlap resilience under low-SNR enrollment compared with traditional mel-spectrogram front-ends.

**Streaming online diarization and 2023–2025 neural advances**: Vanilla EEND-EDA must read an entire multi-minute recording before decoding attractors, failing live-captioning latency budgets. Bringing neural multi-label diarization into chunked streaming operation follows two primary routes: first, the **Speaker-Tracing Buffer (STB)** ([Xue et al., IEEE SLT 2021](https://doi.org/10.1109/SLT48900.2021.9383523)), which prepends a compact buffer of historical representative frames with already-established identities before each incoming $1$–$2\ \mathrm{s}$ chunk so self-attention preserves consistent slot numbering across chunks and prevents inter-chunk permutation jumps; second, **Global and Local Attractors (EEND-GLA)** ([Horiguchi et al., IEEE/ACM TASLP 2023](https://doi.org/10.1109/TASLP.2022.3233237)), which detects overlap inside short chunks via local attractors and incrementally merges chunk attractors into an unbounded global speaker inventory via unsupervised online clustering. More recently, multi-label diarization has advanced through powerset classification and arrival-order objectives: Plaquet & Bredin ([Interspeech 2023](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2023-205)) introduced **powerset multi-class diarization** in `pyannote.audio` 3.x, classifying single-speaker and overlapping combinations directly to eliminate sensitive binary threshold tuning; **Sortformer** ([Park et al., ICML 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.06656)) replaces permutation-invariant training with arrival-order Sort Loss, while its follow-up **Streaming Sortformer** ([Medennikov, Park et al., Interspeech 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.18446)) adds an Arrival-Order Speaker Cache (AOSC) for online streaming inference; and **DiariZen** ([Han et al., ICASSP 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.09408)) integrates weighted WavLM layer representations, Conformer powerset local diarization, and agglomerative hierarchical clustering with cannot-link constraints into a high-accuracy hybrid meeting pipeline.

locator_hits_first5.text: 在日常算法迭代中，开源无参考神经评分器与全参考客观指标显著加快了自动化回归，代表工具包括微软公开的 [`DNSMOS` 本地推理代码](https://github.com/microsoft/DNS-Challenge/tree/591184a9fcb2cbdec02520fed81a32bbbf9d73ff/DNSMOS)（Reddy、Gopal 与 Cutler 2021/2022，*IEEE ICASSP*，区分常规降噪与个性化模型）、[`AECMOS` 本地评估工具](https://github.com/microsoft/AEC-Challenge/tree/6c633d0a9d2a143a0e364899b91b06f127315b18/AECMOS)、预测总体质量与噪度/色染等四维分量的无参考模型 `NISQA`（Mittag 等 2021，*Interspeech*），以及计算短时客观可懂度的 [`pystoi` 实现](https://github.com/mpariente/pystoi/blob/74872b000753a7a42ff51aa0868af8c82c7f9053/pystoi/stoi.py)（支持 STOI 与 ESTOI）。近年社区进一步涌现出三类针对自监督泛化与精细失真归因的无参考神经评分器：基于自监督语音表征预测听感平均分的 **`UTMOS`**（Saeki 等 2022，*Interspeech*）、引入三元组度量学习以兼顾跨语料单调排序与不匹配参考/无参考双模式的 **`SCOREQ`**（Ragano 等 2024，*NeurIPS*），以及对齐 **ITU-T P.804** 多维主观量表、在 $48\ \mathrm{kHz}$ 全频带同时输出音色染色（`COL`）、断续（`DISC`）、响度（`LOUD`）、噪声（`NOISE`）、混响（`REVERB`）、信号失真（`SIG`）与总分（`OVRL`）七维诊断结果的 **`SIGMOS`**（Ristea 等 2024，*IEEE ICASSP*）。而在企业会议室免提硬件商用准入（如 Microsoft Teams Rooms 与 Zoom Rooms 硬件认证）中，还须将加权终端耦合损耗（`TCLw`）、**ETSI TS 103 224** 多扬声器背景声场复现与 **ETSI TS 103 106（`3QUEST`）** 含噪三维语音质量联合纳入硬门槛（详见[第 11 章 §11.5.1](11_selection-guide.md#sec-11-5-1)）。
| SCOREQ（NeurIPS 2024） | 支持无参考与不匹配参考模式，后者使用另一段干净参考，不要求逐样本对齐；三元组度量学习 | $16\ \mathrm{kHz}$ 跨域语音 | 跨域排序鲁棒性较强，但无参考模式仍难替代真实回声/双讲与 P.808 听测 |

For fast daily CI regression, open-source non-intrusive neural estimators and full-reference metrics include Microsoft's [`DNSMOS` local inference scripts](https://github.com/microsoft/DNS-Challenge/tree/591184a9fcb2cbdec02520fed81a32bbbf9d73ff/DNSMOS) (Reddy, Gopal & Cutler, 2021/2022, *IEEE ICASSP*; standard vs. personalized `pDNSMOS`), [`AECMOS` local evaluator](https://github.com/microsoft/AEC-Challenge/tree/6c633d0a9d2a143a0e364899b91b06f127315b18/AECMOS), the 4-D quality/noisiness/coloration/discontinuity predictor `NISQA` (Mittag et al., 2021, *Interspeech*), and [`pystoi`](https://github.com/mpariente/pystoi/blob/74872b000753a7a42ff51aa0868af8c82c7f9053/pystoi/stoi.py) (STOI and ESTOI). More recently, three additional non-intrusive neural quality estimators have gained traction for stronger cross-domain generalization and finer distortion attribution: **`UTMOS`** (Saeki et al., 2022, *Interspeech*), leveraging self-supervised speech representations to predict overall MOS; **`SCOREQ`** (Ragano et al., 2024, *NeurIPS*), trained with triplet metric learning to support both no-reference and non-matching-reference scoring (the latter uses a different clean utterance rather than an aligned clean version) with monotonic cross-corpus ranking; and **`SIGMOS`** (Ristea et al., 2024, *IEEE ICASSP*), aligned with **ITU-T P.804** to output seven fullband $48\ \mathrm{kHz}$ diagnostic scores—coloration (`COL`), discontinuity (`DISC`), loudness (`LOUD`), noisiness (`NOISE`), reverberation (`REVERB`), signal distortion (`SIG`), and overall quality (`OVRL`). Enterprise conference-room hardware certification (Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms) further mandates Weighted Terminal Coupling Loss (`TCLw`), **ETSI TS 103 224** multi-loudspeaker ambient sound-field reproduction, and **ETSI TS 103 106 (`3QUEST`)** 3-D noisy speech quality (see [Chapter 11, §11.5.1](11_selection-guide.md#sec-11-5-1)).

| SCOREQ (NeurIPS 2024) | No-reference and non-matching-reference triplet learning; NMR uses a different clean utterance, not a sample-aligned reference | $16\ \mathrm{kHz}$ cross-domain | Strong cross-corpus rank robustness, yet non-intrusive mode still needs echo/double-talk & P.808 checks |

图 83 将上述视听同步、滞后吃字与多说话人架构等待窗口放在同一组对照坐标中：
- **子图 (d) 架构等待预算示意**：横轴为假定的上下文等待（s），对比流式条件提取 $0.032$、构造的分块联合识别 $1.2$ 与离线全局日志/GSS链 $4.5$。这些是架构示例，不是原 SOT 或 DiCoW 的论文或设备实测延迟。
#### 级联链路（Diarization → GSS → ASR）与联合架构（SOT / DiCoW）对比

当工程团队接到“开发一套支持重叠抢话的远场多人会议纪要系统”任务时，架构评审往往集中在两条技术路线的取舍上：一条是在 CHiME-6 / CHiME-7 / CHiME-8 DASR 及真实办公会议基准 **NOTSOFAR-1**（[Vinnikov 等，Interspeech 2024](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1788)）等远场多通道评测中经受长期检验的**模块化级联架构**（多通道 TS-VAD 日志 $\to$ WPE 去混响 + GSS 空间掩码波束形成 $\to$ 单人语音识别大模型 ASR）；另一条是近年快速崛起的**端到端或条件化大模型联合架构**，代表方案包括序列化输出训练（Serialized Output Training，SOT，[Kanda 等，Interspeech 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.12687)）与日志条件化 Whisper（Diarization-Conditioned Whisper，DiCoW，[Polok 等，*Computer Speech & Language* Vol. 95, 2026](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csl.2025.101841)）。
| SOT | Serialized Output Training | Concatenating overlapping multi-speaker transcripts ordered by speech onset via special speaker-change tokens for single-decoder output |

2. **Background noise subtraction from solo observation covariance (eliminating low-SNR Souden MVDR distortion bias)**: Never equate the solo observation covariance $\hat{\mathbf R}_{xx,\mathrm{solo}}^{(k)}$ directly to the clean target speech covariance $\hat{\mathbf R}_{ss}^{(k)}$. Even during solo target frames, the array captures "target speech plus ambient background noise" ($\vec x_t = \vec a_k s_{k,t} + \vec n_t$), whose expectation equals $\mathbf R_{ss}^{(k)} + \mathbf R_{nn}$. Substituting unsubtracted $\hat{\mathbf R}_{xx,\mathrm{solo}}^{(k)}$ directly into Souden MVDR under isotropic white noise $\mathbf R_{vv} = \sigma_n^2\mathbf I_M$ and per-microphone SNR $\rho = \phi_s / \sigma_n^2$ (with unit-modulus steering vector $|a_{k,m}| = 1$ and reference-microphone normalization $a_{k,r} = 1$, or normalized passband ratio $\vec w_k^H\vec a_k / a_{k,r}$ in general) yields in three lines:

- **Subplot (d) Illustrative architecture waiting budgets**: Horizontal axis shows assumed context waiting (s): streaming conditional extraction $0.032$, a constructed chunked joint recognizer $1.2$, and an offline global-diarization/GSS chain $4.5$. These are architecture examples, not measured or published latency claims for the original SOT or DiCoW models.
#### Cascaded Pipelines (Diarization → GSS → ASR) vs. Joint Architectures (SOT / DiCoW)

When an engineering team is tasked with building a far-field multi-party meeting transcription system capable of handling overlapping cross-talk, architecture reviews invariably center on choosing between two technical paradigms: on one side stands the well-established **modular cascaded pipeline** proven across CHiME-6 / CHiME-7 / CHiME-8 DASR and real office-meeting benchmarks such as **NOTSOFAR-1** ([Vinnikov et al., Interspeech 2024](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1788)) (multi-channel TS-VAD diarization $\to$ WPE dereverberation + GSS spatial-mask beamforming $\to$ single-speaker large ASR model); on the other side stand rapidly advancing **end-to-end or conditioned foundation-model joint architectures**, epitomized by Serialized Output Training (SOT, [Kanda et al., Interspeech 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.12687)) and Diarization-Conditioned Whisper (DiCoW, [Polok et al., *Computer Speech & Language*, Vol. 95, 2026](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csl.2025.101841)).

locator_hits_first5.text: #### 研究方向九：全双工语音大模型（Audio-LLM / Speech-to-Speech）与空间听觉大模型（Spatial-LLM）时代的前端定位

语音大模型已有不同的输入输出形式。[Moshi](https://kyutai.org/assets/pdfs/Moshi.pdf) 同时建模用户与系统语音流，用于全双工语音对话；[Qwen2-Audio](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2-audio/) 接收音频与文本，生成文本回答。BAT、Spatial-AST 等模型则进一步研究双耳与空间声场理解。做前端处理时，先看后端需要听清哪些声音、保留哪些空间线索。

- **按后端任务比较前端输出**：[Mimi](https://kyutai.org/assets/pdfs/Moshi.pdf#page=10)、[EnCodec](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.13438) 和 [DAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.06546) 都把音频编码为离散词元。前端处理改变谱形或相位时，编码结果也可能改变。可以在同一批录音上比较基本前端、追加后滤波的前端，以及按比例加回原始观测的版本。语音识别可比较词错误率，全双工对话可检查打断开头是否保留，空间任务则可检查方位判断。观测加回的做法见[第 10 章 §10.3.1](10_engineering-practice.md#sec-10-3-1)。后端若还接收空间和活动信息，可同时传入 DOA 轨迹和发言时段，并说明时间戳以哪个设备的时钟为准。

Audio language models differ in their input and output modalities. [Moshi](https://kyutai.org/assets/pdfs/Moshi.pdf) models user and system speech streams for full-duplex spoken dialogue. [Qwen2-Audio](https://qwenlm.github.io/blog/qwen2-audio/) accepts audio and text and generates text responses. BAT and Spatial-AST investigate binaural and spatial-sound understanding. The downstream task determines which sounds the front end should make clear and which spatial cues it should preserve.

- **Comparing front-end outputs for the downstream task**: [Mimi](https://kyutai.org/assets/pdfs/Moshi.pdf#page=10), [EnCodec](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.13438), and [DAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.06546) encode audio as discrete tokens. Changes in spectrum or phase at the front end can change the encoded tokens. Use the same recordings to compare a baseline front end, a version with post-filtering, and a version that mixes some of the original observation back in. Measure word error rate for speech recognition, check whether full-duplex dialogue retains the start of an interruption, or check direction estimates for spatial tasks. See [Chapter 10, §10.3.1](10_engineering-practice.md#sec-10-3-1) for observation adding. If the downstream interface also accepts spatial and activity information, pass DOA tracks and speaking intervals with the clock used for their timestamps.

locator_hits_first5.text: 对于传统阵列信号处理核心（频域能量谱、空间协方差矩阵 $\hat{\mathbf{R}}_{xx}=\sum_t\vec{x}_t\vec{x}_t^H$、MVDR/WPE 线性方程组求解），纯 16 位定点格式（如 `Q1.15`）面临最严峻的挑战是**二次方运算导致的动态范围塌缩**。不妨算一笔直观的定点精度账：有符号 16 位 PCM 的最小非零码字幅度比为 $2^{-15}\approx -90.3\ \mathrm{dBFS}$（注意与满幅正弦均匀量化信噪比 $\mathrm{SQNR}=6.02\times 16+1.76\approx 98.1\ \mathrm{dB}$ 相区分，后者比较的是满幅正弦平均功率 $1/2$ 与均匀量化噪声方差 $\Delta^2/12$）。假设远场轻声说话人在某个高频子带的复谱分量幅度处于完全正常的 $-42\ \mathrm{dBFS}$（线性幅度约 $2^{-7}\approx 0.0078$，对应 `Q1.15` 整数码字 $256$）；一旦直接计算功率或协方差外积并存回 16 位 `Q1.15`，平方后的实数幅度变为 $(2^{-7})^2=2^{-14}$，对应的 `Q1.15` 整数码字骤降为 $256^2/32768=2$，有效尾数精度坍缩到只剩 $1\ \mathrm{bit}$。

为了在没有硬件浮点单元（或浮点功耗/吞吐受限）的嵌入式音频 DSP 上兼顾高动态范围与高吞吐，工业界（如 XMOS `lib_xcore_math`、ADI SHARC 与 Cadence HiFi 语音库）广泛采用**块浮点（Block Floating-Point，BFP）**表示法：让同一个数据块（例如一帧 $N$ 个频点或同一频点的 $M$ 维通道向量）共享**唯一一个整型指数 $e_{\mathrm{blk}}$**，块内各元素保存 16 位或 32 位有符号整型尾数向量 $\vec{m}$，此处采用归一化尾数口径，真值为 $\vec{x}=(\vec{m}/2^{B_m-1})\,2^{e_{\mathrm{blk}}}$，其中 $B_m$ 为有符号码字位数；整数尾数口径的指数为 $e_{\mathrm{int}}=e_{\mathrm{blk}}-(B_m-1)$。每次执行蝶形变换、外积或矩阵加减之前，BFP 内核先扫描整块尾数的冗余前导符号位数（`headroom`，不计必需的符号位，取整块可安全左移的最小位数），扣除当前算子所需的保护位 $s_{\mathrm{guard}}$ 后，选择块移位量 $s=\mathrm{headroom}-s_{\mathrm{guard}}$（非负时左移，负时相应右移），同时把共享指数更新为 $e_{\mathrm{blk}}\leftarrow e_{\mathrm{blk}}-s$。

仍以上述峰值码字为 $256$（$-42\ \mathrm{dBFS}$）的 `Q1.15` 弱信号块逐位复算：$256=2^8$ 的16位有符号码字拥有 $6\ \mathrm{bit}$ 冗余符号位。本例只演示采用宽乘积的单值平方，取 $s_{\mathrm{guard}}=0$，故左移 $6$ 位至 $16384$，并记录 $e_{\mathrm{blk}}=-6$；此时码字已没有可再左移的冗余位，必需符号位不等于一位加法保护位。若下一步要将两个这样的正码字相加，则应预留一位、只左移 $5$ 位。沿本例的六位移位继续平方，尾数为 $16384^2/32768=8192$，共享指数为 $2e_{\mathrm{blk}}=-12$，对应真值 $8192\times2^{-15}\times2^{-12}=2^{-14}$，有效尾数精度从纯 `Q1.15` 的 **$1\ \mathrm{bit}$ 提升至 $13\ \mathrm{bit}$**，额外存储代价是每块一个整型指数。
当然，数值表示位宽与统计可逆性属于两个层面的问题：即便采用了 BFP 或 32 位宽定点避免了弱信号平方下溢，当观测快拍不足或存在强相干干扰导致空间协方差矩阵接近秩亏时，线性方程组求解仍必须配合按矩阵迹（平均特征值）成比例缩放的对角加载，宽尾数本身绝不能替代统计正则化。
#### Q1.15 的乘积、累加与输出取整

In classical array cores (power spectra, spatial covariances $\hat{\mathbf{R}}_{xx}=\sum_t\vec{x}_t\vec{x}_t^H$, MVDR/WPE linear solves), naive 16-bit fixed-point (`Q1.15`) hits a wall on **dynamic-range collapse under squaring**. Checking the bit precision directly: signed 16-bit PCM has smallest nonzero magnitude $2^{-15}\approx -90.3\ \mathrm{dBFS}$ (distinct from full-scale sine $\mathrm{SQNR}=6.02\times 16+1.76\approx 98.1\ \mathrm{dB}$, comparing sine power $1/2$ to $\Delta^2/12$). Suppose a quiet far-field talker has a typical $-42\ \mathrm{dBFS}$ high-band spectral bin (amplitude $2^{-7}\approx 0.0078$, `Q1.15` integer $256$); squaring directly back into `Q1.15` yields $(2^{-7})^2=2^{-14}$, collapsing code $256^2/32768=2$ down to **$1\ \mathrm{bit}$ of mantissa precision**.

Worse yet, every weak speech bin or quiet noise floor at or below $-48.2\ \mathrm{dBFS}$ (`Q1.15` $|X|\le\sqrt{16384}=128$ under round-to-nearest-even $\operatorname{rne}$ where $128^2/2^{15}=0.5$ rounds to even $0$; or $-45.2\ \mathrm{dBFS}$, $|X|\le 181$ under truncation) **underflows completely to exact machine zero**, leaving SCMs singular and diagonal loading mis-scaled. Conversely, in a $512$-point fixed-point FFT where butterfly stages grow up to $1\ \mathrm{bit}$ per stage ($9\ \mathrm{bits}$ across $9$ stages), unconditional $1/2$ right-shifting at every stage throws away $9\ \mathrm{bits}$ ($54\ \mathrm{dB}$) of quiet-signal SNR.

To preserve wide dynamic range at integer throughput without FPU power overhead, industrial DSP libraries (XMOS `lib_xcore_math`, ADI SHARC, Cadence HiFi) use **Block Floating-Point (BFP)**: an entire block (e.g., $N$ bins of a frame or an $M$-mic vector) shares **a single integer exponent $e_{\mathrm{blk}}$** alongside 16- or 32-bit signed mantissas $\vec{m}$, using normalized mantissas $\vec{x}=(\vec{m}/2^{B_m-1})\,2^{e_{\mathrm{blk}}}$ for signed $B_m$-bit codes (the integer-mantissa convention instead uses $e_{\mathrm{int}}=e_{\mathrm{blk}}-(B_m-1)$). Before butterflies, outer products, or matrix additions, BFP scans block `headroom` (redundant leading sign bits excluding the required sign bit, taking the minimum safe count across the block), subtracts operator guard bits $s_{\mathrm{guard}}$, selects shift $s=\mathrm{headroom}-s_{\mathrm{guard}}$ (left for nonnegative $s$, right for negative $s$), and updates $e_{\mathrm{blk}}\leftarrow e_{\mathrm{blk}}-s$.

For the peak-$256$ ($-42\ \mathrm{dBFS}$) `Q1.15` block, a signed 16-bit code has six redundant leading sign bits. This single-value squaring example uses a wide product and $s_{\mathrm{guard}}=0$: shifting by six gives $16384$ with $e_{\mathrm{blk}}=-6$. The shifted code has no remaining left-shift headroom; its required sign bit is not an extra addition guard bit. Adding two such positive codes would require reserving one bit and shifting by only five. Continuing the six-bit squaring example gives mantissa $16384^2/32768=8192$ and exponent $2e_{\mathrm{blk}}=-12$, representing $8192\times2^{-15}\times2^{-12}=2^{-14}$ exactly. Mantissa precision rises from **one bit to 13 bits**, at the cost of one shared integer exponent per block.

Backpropagation through Eq. (8-5) follows the **active permutation branch**. When the minimizing permutation $\pi^\star$ is unique and pairwise losses are differentiable, the local gradient is exactly that branch's gradient, routed through the selected pairs $(\hat s_n,s_{\pi^\star(n)})$. At an exact tie the objective may be nondifferentiable, so an implementation must specify branch selection or gradient combination. This automatic-differentiation convention is not a convex-subgradient guarantee: a pointwise minimum of losses is generally nonconvex, as $\min(x,-x)=-|x|$ shows at zero.

locator_hits_first5.text: 阅读这些前沿文献时，需要留心理论证明覆盖范围与实验观察之间的界限：例如 GEVD-DANSE 原论文对顺序轮转更新给出了严格证明，而对同时更新则主要展示实验收敛表现（参见 [Hassani 等 2016，§IV-B/C/F 与 §V-A](https://ftp.esat.kuleuven.be/SISTA/abertran/reports/GEVD_DS_TSP2016.pdf)）；SRO 感知 DANSE 利用连续帧间相干乘积追踪晶振频偏，再拆分为逐频点分数时延相位旋转与帧移整数样本跳步补偿，绝非只给整帧乘一个与频率无关的常数相移（参见 Didier、van Waterschoot、Doclo 与 Moonen，*IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing*，vol. 4，第 71～79 页，2023 / [arXiv:2211.02489v2 §IV-A～C 式(11)～(20)](https://arxiv.org/html/2211.02489v2)；其上游盲 SRO 估计器如 WACD/DWACD 与 DXCP-PhaT 详见 §13.15）。
4. **同步估计中相关段与语音活动门控的一致切片**：在基于跨帧互相关的在线时钟偏移跟踪（如 §13.15 介绍的 DWACD）中，计算互相关的时延切片与统计有效语音点数的 VAD 门控切片必须严格对应同一物理时间区间；一旦门控窗宽于互相关切片，尾部语音活动就会误放行静音相关段，使时延峰估计落入纯底噪。

实现式(13-24)时必须同时核对**共轭符号约定**与**相位卷绕上界**两项约束：第一，在全书 $\hat\Gamma_{12} = \hat{\mathbb{E}}[X_1 X_2^*]$ 约定下，$\varepsilon > 0$ 产生正相位斜率（例如 $f_s = 16\,\mathrm{kHz}$、$\varepsilon = +100\,\mathrm{ppm}$、$f_k = 2\,\mathrm{kHz}$、$H = 128$、$L = 10$ 时 $\arg P_k \approx +0.1005\,\mathrm{rad}$）；若代码改用某些 DWACD 文献中的反向共轭 $\hat{\mathbb{E}}[X_1^* X_2]$ 或互换基准节点，估计出的 $\hat\varepsilon$ 符号会随之翻转，若未配套取反便送入重采样器，反而会把原始频偏放大一倍。第二，为避免最高分析频率 $f_{\max}$（通常为 $f_s / 2$）处跨越 $L$ 帧的相位增量超出 $(-\pi, \pi)$ 发生 $2\pi$ 卷绕模糊，须满足无卷绕条件 $|\varepsilon| L H f_{\max} / f_s < 1/2$（例如 $|\varepsilon| = 100\,\mathrm{ppm}$ 且 $f_{\max} = f_s / 2$ 时，须控制 $L H < 10^4$ 个采样点）。

基于式(13-24)的相干漂移机理，学术与工程界形成了两条代表性盲 SRO 估计路线：其一是**加权平均相干漂移（WACD）及其动态在线版本 DWACD**（Gburrek、Schmalenstroeer 与 Haeb-Umbach，ICASSP 2022），通过对 $P_k[\ell]$ 做跨频加权相位斜率回归或逆离散傅里叶变换寻峰估计 $\hat\varepsilon$，并配合语音活动门控动态刷新参考段以跟踪温漂与说话人切换；其二是**双互相关相位变换处理器（DXCP-PhaT）**（Chinaev、Thüne 与 Enzner，*IEEE/ACM TASLP* vol. 29，第 1881～1896 页，2021），通过在 STFT 域构造经相位变换白化的二阶互相关量，恢复漂移互谱的遍历性，在强混响与大间距节点下同时实现盲 SRO 与残余时间偏移（STO）的稳健在线估计，从而与 §13.12 的 SRO 感知 DANSE（Didier 等，*IEEE OJSP* 2023）组成闭环。会议任务还应与 SRO 算法原实验分开核对：CHiME-5/6/7/8 的设备拓扑与同步、分离、识别协议随任务变化，不能将挑战赛名本身当作 DWACD/DXCP-PhaT 与分布式波束、GSS 联合运行收益的证据。[NOTSOFAR-1（Vinnikov等，Interspeech 2024，§2）](https://www.isca-archive.org/interspeech_2024/vinnikov24_interspeech.pdf)原任务为单设备单通道/多通道远场识别，刻意避开多设备复杂性；可用它研究相应会议前端，但原基准不是异步多设备 SRO 评测。

第一步先将远端环形输入缓冲区的读指针前移 $+m_\ell$ 个样本（从索引 $\ell H + m_\ell$ 开始取帧；$\varepsilon > 0$ 时每当 $m_\ell$ 加 $1$ 便跳过 $1$ 个输入样本，$\varepsilon < 0$ 时每当 $m_\ell$ 减 $1$ 便回退 $1$ 个样本），由此得到的滑移帧频谱 $X_q^{(\mathrm{slip})}[k,\ell]$ 仅保留幅值不超过半个样本的滞后 $+\Delta_\ell$（对应残余相位 $e^{-\mathrm{j}\frac{2\pi k}{N}\Delta_\ell}$）；第二步直接在正频点 $k = 0, \dots, N/2$ 上乘以**正号**线性相位旋转因子 $\exp\!\big(+\mathrm{j}\frac{2\pi k}{N}\Delta_\ell\big)$（全长 $N$ 点复谱的负频点取共轭对称，奈奎斯特频点取实部）在带限及帧内时差近似恒定的条件下补偿残余相位——若误用负号，分数滞后非但不会被消去，反而会加倍。需要注意这一频域近似的**帧内漂移有效界**：用单一相位斜坡替代连续重采样默认整帧 $N$ 个采样点内的时钟偏移近似恒定，仅在帧内总漂移满足 $|\varepsilon| N \ll 1$ 时成立（例如 $\varepsilon = 100\,\mathrm{ppm}$、$N = 512$ 时 $|\varepsilon| N = 0.0512 \ll 1$，即使在奈奎斯特频率处窗边缘相位偏差也低于 $4.6^\circ$）；若遭遇剧烈频偏或超长窗导致 $|\varepsilon| N \gtrsim 0.5$，帧内时间伸缩将引发相邻频点间的谱泄漏涂抹，无法再靠逐频点相位乘法消除，必须退回时域加窗 sinc 或 Farrow 多项式重采样（关于 DWACD 启发的双窗互谱斜率控制与活动门控的定量验证见 [E13-21](#e13-21)）。

Note the boundary between theoretical proofs and empirical observations: GEVD-DANSE proves sequential round-robin convergence rigorously while demonstrating simultaneous updates empirically ([Hassani et al. 2016, §§IV-B/C/F & V-A](https://ftp.esat.kuleuven.be/SISTA/abertran/reports/GEVD_DS_TSP2016.pdf)); SRO-aware DANSE tracks crystal frequency offset via inter-frame coherence products and decomposes it into per-bin fractional-delay linear phase slopes plus integer frame-shift slips rather than a frequency-flat constant phase (Didier, van Waterschoot, Doclo, & Moonen, *IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing*, vol. 4, pp. 71–79, 2023 / [arXiv:2211.02489v2 §§IV-A–C Eqs. (11)–(20)](https://arxiv.org/html/2211.02489v2); upstream blind SRO estimators such as WACD/DWACD and DXCP-PhaT are detailed in §13.15).

4. **Aligned correlation and VAD gating windows in synchronization trackers**: In online cross-frame cross-correlation clock-drift trackers (such as DWACD in §13.15), the cross-correlation slice and the active-speech VAD gating window must span the exact same physical time interval; a wider gating window allows trailing speech to pass a noise-only correlation slice through the gate and bias the delay peak.

Implementing Eq. (13-24) requires verifying both the **conjugation sign convention** and the **phase-unwrapping bound**. First, under $\hat\Gamma_{12} = \hat{\mathbb{E}}[X_1 X_2^*]$, positive $\varepsilon > 0$ produces a positive phase slope (e.g., at $f_s = 16\,\mathrm{kHz}, \varepsilon = +100\,\mathrm{ppm}, f_k = 2\,\mathrm{kHz}, H = 128, L = 10$, $\arg P_k \approx +0.1005\,\mathrm{rad}$); flipping conjugation to $\hat{\mathbb{E}}[X_1^* X_2]$ (as used in some DWACD derivations) or swapping the reference node flips the sign of $\hat\varepsilon$, and feeding the negated estimate into an SRC doubles the drift instead of cancelling it. Second, to prevent $2\pi$ phase wrapping over lag $L$ up to the maximum analyzed frequency $f_{\max}$ (typically $f_s / 2$), total phase rotation must stay strictly inside $(-\pi, \pi)$, imposing the unambiguous lag bound $|\varepsilon| L H f_{\max} / f_s < 1/2$ (e.g., for $|\varepsilon| = 100\,\mathrm{ppm}$ and $f_{\max} = f_s / 2$, $L H < 10^4$ samples).

Building on the coherence-drift mechanism in Eq. (13-24), two flagship blind SRO estimation families have emerged across academia and industry: first, **Weighted Average Coherence Drift (WACD) and its online dynamic variant DWACD** (Gburrek, Schmalenstroeer, & Haeb-Umbach, ICASSP 2022), which estimates $\hat\varepsilon$ via cross-frequency weighted phase-slope regression or inverse-DFT peak search on $P_k[\ell]$ paired with VAD-gated dynamic reference refreshes to track thermal crystal drift and talker switches; and second, the **Double Cross-Correlation Processor with Phase Transform (DXCP-PhaT)** (Chinaev, Thüne, & Enzner, *IEEE/ACM TASLP* vol. 29, pp. 1881–1896, 2021), which constructs a phase-transform-whitened second-order cross-correlation in the STFT domain to restore ergodicity of drifting cross-spectra, achieving robust online blind SRO and residual sampling time offset (STO) estimation even under strong reverberation and wide inter-node spacing—closing the loop with §13.12's SRO-aware DANSE (Didier et al., *IEEE OJSP* 2023). Meeting benchmarks need a separate task-level check. CHiME-5/6/7/8 differ in device topology and synchronization, separation, and recognition protocols; a challenge name alone does not establish a joint DWACD/DXCP-PhaT, distributed-beamforming, and GSS result. [NOTSOFAR-1 (Vinnikov et al., Interspeech 2024, §2)](https://www.isca-archive.org/interspeech_2024/vinnikov24_interspeech.pdf) defines single-device single-/multi-channel far-field recognition tasks, deliberately avoiding multi-device complexity. It supports study of those meeting front-ends, but its original task is not an asynchronous multi-device SRO benchmark.

Step 1 advances node $q$'s circular input-buffer read pointer by $+m_\ell$ samples (reading frame $\ell$ starting at $\ell H + m_\ell$: skipping $1$ input sample whenever $m_\ell$ increments by $+1$ for $\varepsilon > 0$, or stepping back $1$ sample whenever $m_\ell$ decrements for $\varepsilon < 0$), leaving the slipped spectrum $X_q^{(\mathrm{slip})}[k,\ell]$ with only the residual lag $+\Delta_\ell \in [-0.5, 0.5]$ samples (phase $e^{-\mathrm{j}\frac{2\pi k}{N}\Delta_\ell}$). Step 2 multiplies positive-frequency bins $k = 0, \dots, N/2$ by the **positive-sign** linear phase factor $\exp\!\big(+\mathrm{j}\frac{2\pi k}{N}\Delta_\ell\big)$ (with conjugate symmetry on negative bins $k > N/2$ and real Nyquist bin $k = N/2$) to compensate that residual phase under bandlimited, approximately frame-constant delay—flipping this sign would double the residual drift instead of cancelling it. Note the **intra-frame approximation bound**: modeling continuous resampling as a single frame-wide delay $\Delta_\ell$ holds accurately only when intra-frame drift satisfies $|\varepsilon| N \ll 1$ (e.g., at $\varepsilon = 100\,\mathrm{ppm}$ and $N = 512$, $|\varepsilon| N = 0.0512 \ll 1$, holding window-edge phase error under $4.6^\circ$ even at Nyquist); under severe SRO or very long windows with $|\varepsilon| N \gtrsim 0.5$, intra-frame time stretching smears energy across adjacent DFT bins beyond what bin-wise phase multiplication can repair, requiring time-domain windowed-sinc or Farrow resampling instead (see [E13-21](#e13-21) for quantitative verification of the DWACD-inspired two-window control and activity gating).

| **有线以太网 AES67 / PTPv2** | 局域网千兆级无压缩 $48\,\mathrm{kHz}$ PCM24 多通道流 | 确定性亚毫秒至数毫秒交换转发延迟 | 硬件 PTPv2 主从锁相（$< 1\,\mu\mathrm{s}$，零长期 SRO） | 极低丢包率；专业会议吊麦、演播室与固定安装分布式阵列的工业基准传输底座 |

本章核心矩阵与迭代求解器位于 [`codes/chapters/ch13/core/distributed.py`](../codes/chapters/ch13/core/distributed.py)，AES67/PTPv2 相位预算与 DASF 约束子空间求解核位于 [`codes/chapters/ch13/core/dasf_and_ptp.py`](../codes/chapters/ch13/core/dasf_and_ptp.py)，合成音频与传输失配实验位于 [`codes/chapters/ch13/core/distributed_audio.py`](../codes/chapters/ch13/core/distributed_audio.py)。阅读代码时请留意矩阵转置约定：正文公式用列满秩矩阵 $\mathbf T$ 写作 $\tilde{\vec x} = \mathbf T^H\vec x$，而代码接口传入按行排列的观测映射矩阵 $\mathbf B = \mathbf T^H$（复数广播滤波 $\vec f^H\vec x$ 对应共轭行向量 $\vec f^H$）。为兼顾数值条件数与瞬态诊断，求解器在内部先对非零压缩行做范数归一化，并同步记录归一化坐标与原始广播坐标下的局部权重，以及每步更新时刻“上次激活提案权重”与“用当前全网最新广播实时重组的有效权重”两套状态——对照两者即可直接复现图 66(a) 的跨节点瞬态失配尖峰。

前六题围绕复参考共轭、广播尺度不变性、轮转/同时更新状态与多目标广播秩展开，第 7～17 题串联秩亏退化、带宽内存核算、时钟丢包传输、PCM16 误差界与三层稳窗评分、收敛步长条件、树上求和与 GEVD 白化，第 18～21 题进一步手算与复算广播切换统计坐标变换、AES67/PTPv2 亚微秒同步预算、DASF 约束子空间统一框架以及 DWACD 启发的双窗互谱斜率控制与语音活动门控。除题干另有声明外，标量目标默认取 $d = s$、干源功率 $\phi_s = 1$；每次算出有效全局权重后，均代回式(13-3)核对总均方误差。
#### E13-19：AES67/PTPv2亚微秒硬件同步预算与软件SRO-DANSE对照

Hardware clocking comes first in cross-device pickup (for definitions of clock offset, crystal drift, and sample gaps as well as buffering architectures, see [Chapter 10, §10.2](10_engineering-practice.md#sec-10-2) and [§10.7](10_engineering-practice.md#sec-10-7)). Over wired LANs in boardrooms or broadcast studios, **AES67 / IEEE 1588 PTPv2** interfaces suppress sampling-rate drift only when an explicit hardware sample-clock servo disciplines each ADC to the Grandmaster; PTP timestamps alone do not establish this: at $48\,\mathrm{kHz}$, $\pm 1\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ worst-case opposing skew induces a static $1.728^\circ$ phase offset at $2.4\,\mathrm{kHz}$ ($< 0.001\,\mathrm{dB}$ coherent-sum loss).

| **Wired Ethernet AES67 / PTPv2** | Gigabit-LAN uncompressed $48\,\mathrm{kHz}$ PCM24 multichannel streams | Deterministic sub-ms to few-ms switched forwarding latency | Hardware PTPv2 grandmaster phase lock ($< 1\,\mu\mathrm{s}$, zero long-term SRO) | Negligible packet loss; industrial benchmark transport foundation for ceiling conference arrays, broadcast studios, and fixed distributed installations |

Core matrix and iterative solvers live in [`codes/chapters/ch13/core/distributed.py`](../codes/chapters/ch13/core/distributed.py), AES67/PTPv2 phase-budget and DASF constrained-subspace kernels in [`codes/chapters/ch13/core/dasf_and_ptp.py`](../codes/chapters/ch13/core/dasf_and_ptp.py), and synthetic audio/transport mismatch experiments in [`codes/chapters/ch13/core/distributed_audio.py`](../codes/chapters/ch13/core/distributed_audio.py). Note one transpose convention when reading the code: prose writes $\tilde{\vec x} = \mathbf T^H\vec x$ with tall column-full-rank $\mathbf T$, whereas the code accepts row-arranged observation mapping $\mathbf B = \mathbf T^H$ (complex broadcast $\vec f^H\vec x$ corresponds to conjugated row $\vec f^H$). For numerical conditioning and transient diagnostics, the solver normalizes nonzero compressed rows internally and records both normalized-coordinate and raw-broadcast local weights alongside two per-step states—each node's last-active proposal weight and its live effective weight recombined against the network's newest broadcasts—reproducing Fig. 66(a)'s cross-node transient mismatch spikes directly.

Exercises 1–6 cover complex reference conjugation, broadcast-scale invariance, sequential/simultaneous update states, and multi-target broadcast rank; Exercises 7–17 trace rank-deficient fallback, bitrate and RAM accounting, clock/packet-loss transport, PCM16 bounds and three-tier steady-window scoring, convergence step-size rules, tree summation, and GEVD whitening; and Exercises 18–21 examine broadcast-switch coordinate transforms, AES67/PTPv2 sub-microsecond budgets, the unified DASF constrained subspace framework, and a DWACD-inspired two-window cross-spectrum slope control with activity gating. Unless noted otherwise, $d = s$ and $\phi_s = 1$, verifying every effective global weight via Eq. (13-3).

locator_hits_first5.text: 当工程团队接到“开发一套支持重叠抢话的远场多人会议纪要系统”任务时，架构评审往往集中在两条技术路线的取舍上：一条是在 CHiME-6 / CHiME-7 / CHiME-8 DASR 及真实办公会议基准 **NOTSOFAR-1**（[Vinnikov 等，Interspeech 2024](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1788)）等远场多通道评测中经受长期检验的**模块化级联架构**（多通道 TS-VAD 日志 $\to$ WPE 去混响 + GSS 空间掩码波束形成 $\to$ 单人语音识别大模型 ASR）；另一条是近年快速崛起的**端到端或条件化大模型联合架构**，代表方案包括序列化输出训练（Serialized Output Training，SOT，[Kanda 等，Interspeech 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.12687)）与日志条件化 Whisper（Diarization-Conditioned Whisper，DiCoW，[Polok 等，*Computer Speech & Language* Vol. 95, 2026](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csl.2025.101841)）。

为了在同一把标尺上公平评测上表三类异构系统的端到端会议纪要质量，可先用以下通用指标比较多说话人转写；CHiME 各赛道的正式评分须依冻结协议核对，部分采用带 collar 的 tcpWER，不能统称为**拼接最小排列词错率（Concatenated Minimum-Permutation Word Error Rate，`cpWER`，多说话人词错率统一口径见[第 11 章 §11.2](11_selection-guide.md#sec-11-2) 式(11-1)）**。对整场会话中的每位真实说话人 $k$ 与每条系统输出说话人轨 $j$，分别按时间顺序将其全部话段拼接为完整词序列 $\mathcal{W}_k^{\mathrm{ref}}$ 与 $\mathcal{W}_j^{\mathrm{hyp}}$（若预测人数与真实人数不等，较少一方补空词序列 $\varnothing$ 对齐集合基数），遍历全部双射排列 $\pi \in \mathcal{P}$（工程上用[第 0 章 §0.6.4](00_math-foundations.md#sec-0-6-4) 匈牙利算法在多项式时间内精确求解）最小化全局总编辑距离：

发言人串槽可通过删词和插词同时增加错误，但要先分清固定映射与最小排列。在**说话人映射固定、其余词序对齐不变**的控制中，一句正确识别的 $M_w$ 词发言若被挂到另一位参会者轨上，会在真实说话人轨少掉 $M_w$ 词、在另一轨多出 $M_w$ 词，形成 $2M_w$ 次编辑。`cpWER` 还会重新选择整场最优排列，因此不能直接断言它的最小总错数必增 $2M_w$；轨道的其余内容会影响最佳映射与编辑对齐。进一步针对流式系统还需考核**时间约束最小排列词错率（Time-Constrained Minimum-Permutation WER，`tcpWER`，标准评测工具集见 MeetEval，[von Neumann 等，CHiME-7 Workshop 2023](https://doi.org/10.21437/CHiME.2023-6)）**：它在计算词级编辑距离时只允许时间戳偏差落在容限窗口（如 $\pm 5\ \mathrm{s}$）内的参考词与预测词配对，防止离线系统靠跨话轮长距离漂移侥幸抵消时间戳错位（连续分离跨块拼接、评测口径与选型验收规格分别见[第 8 章 §8.6](08_speech-separation.md#sec-8-6)、[第 10 章 §10.5](10_engineering-practice.md#sec-10-5) 与[第 11 章 §11.5.2](11_selection-guide.md#sec-11-5-2)）。面向原生音频大语言模型（Audio-LLM）与全双工语音到语音（Speech-to-Speech）交互系统对多通道打断检测、低延迟去回声与空间目标保持提出的新一代前端需求，可进一步参见[附录 B §17.3](17_appendix-guide.md#sec-17-3) 研究方向九。

When an engineering team is tasked with building a far-field multi-party meeting transcription system capable of handling overlapping cross-talk, architecture reviews invariably center on choosing between two technical paradigms: on one side stands the well-established **modular cascaded pipeline** proven across CHiME-6 / CHiME-7 / CHiME-8 DASR and real office-meeting benchmarks such as **NOTSOFAR-1** ([Vinnikov et al., Interspeech 2024](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1788)) (multi-channel TS-VAD diarization $\to$ WPE dereverberation + GSS spatial-mask beamforming $\to$ single-speaker large ASR model); on the other side stand rapidly advancing **end-to-end or conditioned foundation-model joint architectures**, epitomized by Serialized Output Training (SOT, [Kanda et al., Interspeech 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.12687)) and Diarization-Conditioned Whisper (DiCoW, [Polok et al., *Computer Speech & Language*, Vol. 95, 2026](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csl.2025.101841)).

To evaluate end-to-end meeting transcription quality fairly across all three heterogeneous paradigms on a common ruler, we first define the generic metric below; official CHiME tracks must be checked against their frozen protocols, including tcpWER and its collar, rather than universally labeling every score **Concatenated Minimum-Permutation Word Error Rate (`cpWER`; see the unified multi-speaker WER definitions in [Chapter 11, §11.2](11_selection-guide.md#sec-11-2) Eq. (11-1))**. For each ground-truth speaker $k$ and each system-predicted speaker track $j$ across an entire session, all utterances attributed to that speaker are concatenated chronologically into full word sequences $\mathcal{W}_k^{\mathrm{ref}}$ and $\mathcal{W}_j^{\mathrm{hyp}}$ (if predicted and reference speaker counts differ, the smaller set is padded with empty word sequences $\varnothing$ to match cardinality), and the global edit distance is minimized over all bijective permutations $\pi \in \mathcal{P}$ (solved exactly in polynomial time via the Hungarian algorithm of [Chapter 0 §0.6.4](00_math-foundations.md#sec-0-6-4)):

Speaker-attribution errors can incur both deletions and insertions, but distinguish a fixed mapping from global permutation minimization. With **speaker mapping fixed and the remaining word alignment unchanged**, assigning an otherwise correct $M_w$-word utterance to another track removes $M_w$ words from the true speaker's track and adds them to the other, producing $2M_w$ edits. `cpWER` also reselects the best session-wide permutation, so its minimum total need not increase by $2M_w$; the rest of the tracks affect both mapping and edit alignment. Streaming evaluations further enforce **Time-Constrained Minimum-Permutation WER (`tcpWER`; implemented in the standard MeetEval toolkit, [von Neumann et al., CHiME-7 Workshop 2023](https://doi.org/10.21437/CHiME.2023-6))**, which permits pairing a reference word with a hypothesis word during edit-distance alignment only when their timestamps fall within a tolerance collar (e.g., $\pm 5\ \mathrm{s}$), preventing offline systems from masking timestamp drift across distant conversational turns (for continuous-separation chunk stitching, evaluation protocols, and selection acceptance specifications, see [Chapter 8 §8.6](08_speech-separation.md#sec-8-6), [Chapter 10 §10.5](10_engineering-practice.md#sec-10-5), and [Chapter 11 §11.5.2](11_selection-guide.md#sec-11-5-2)). For emerging front-end implications placed on multi-channel barge-in detection, low-latency echo cancellation, and spatial target retention by native Audio-LLMs and full-duplex speech-to-speech systems, see Direction 9 in [Appendix B, §17.3](17_appendix-guide.md#sec-17-3).

式(11-1)清晰揭示了三者的约束递进关系：当 $S=K=1$ 且实名标签正确时，三式完全退化为普通单人 WER；在多人场景下，ORC-WER 的可行重排空间最大（共有 $K^U$ 种逐话段指派），cpWER 将重排收紧到整场唯一的 $M!$ 种全局槽位置换，而 sa-WER 将重排自由度彻底收紧到 $1$ 种固定实名映射，因此对同一组转写内容恒有 $\text{ORC-WER} \le \text{cpWER} \le \text{sa-WER}$（当实名标签由槽位全局一一绑定产生时；连续语音分离流式拼接下的 `cpWER` / `ORC-WER` 对比另见[第 8 章 §8.6](08_speech-separation.md#sec-8-6)，级联与端到端会议架构下的 `cpWER` 双倍惩罚机理及 `tcpWER` 另见[第 15 章 §15.7](15_target-extraction-diarization.md#sec-15-7)）。

不带时间约束的编辑距离还会引入另一重隐患：在长达数十分钟的会议录音里，“好”“对”“是的”等高频词反复出现，普通动态规划会把第 1 秒漏掉的参考词拿去与第 10 分钟误插入的同词配成“零错误”（见 [E11-17](#e11-17)）。为此，[MeetEval 2023 原论文 §4（印刷第 29～30 页）](https://www.isca-archive.org/chime_2023/neumann23_chime.pdf)引入了时间约束最小排列词错误率（Time-Constrained minimum-Permutation Word Error Rate，tcpWER），规定只有当参考词与假设词的时间区间在预定容差（collar）内发生重叠时，才允许作正确匹配或替换。使用时间约束指标时，必须同步写明词级时间戳来自人工标注、强制对齐还是按字符长度比例近似，并核对端点刚好相接时算不算重叠。

阅读公开评测榜单时，同样要先核对聚合分母与评分协议细节。以同届 CHiME-8 挑战赛为例，[Task 1（DASR）提交说明](https://www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime8/task1/submission)采用 $5\ \mathrm{s}$ 容差的 tcpWER，其[官方评分工具 `chime-utils`](https://github.com/chimechallenge/chime-utils)先在每个场景内部合并全部错误词数与参考词数，再对四个场景的分数取等权算术平均；而 [Task 2（NOTSOFAR）规则](https://www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime8/task2/rules)虽同样采用 $5\ \mathrm{s}$ 容差，其[官方榜单](https://www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime8/task2/results)却先逐场会话算出 tcpWER、再对各会话分数取等权平均，并额外并列报告不绑固定说话人的 tcORC-WER 供诊断参考。跨届对比更须谨慎：例如 [CHiME-9](https://www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime9/) 转向了 MCoRec 与助听会话增强任务 ECHI，数据集、通道拓扑与评测指标均已改变，不能把两届数字直接排在同一张名次表里。

Equation (11-1) clearly reveals the nested hierarchy of constraints across the three metrics: when $S=K=1$ and the speaker label is correct, all three reduce identically to standard single-speaker WER; in multi-speaker scenarios, ORC-WER enjoys the largest feasible reassignment space ($K^U$ utterance-level assignments), cpWER tightens reassignment to $M!$ session-wide slot permutations, and sa-WER collapses reassignment freedom entirely to $1$ fixed identity mapping, yielding the universal ordering $\text{ORC-WER} \le \text{cpWER} \le \text{sa-WER}$ on the exact same transcribed words (whenever real-name labels are produced via a one-to-one global binding to output slots; for `cpWER` vs. `ORC-WER` under streaming CSS stitching see [Chapter 8, §8.6](08_speech-separation.md#sec-8-6), and for `cpWER`'s double-penalty mechanics and `tcpWER` across cascaded vs. joint meeting architectures see [Chapter 15, §15.7](15_target-extraction-diarization.md#sec-15-7)).

Unconstrained edit distance without timing introduces a second pitfall: in tens-of-minutes-long meeting recordings where high-frequency backchannels such as "okay," "right," and "yes" recur constantly, standard dynamic programming will pair a reference word missed at $1\ \mathrm{s}$ with an identical word spuriously inserted at $10\ \mathrm{min}$ for "zero error" (see [E11-17](#e11-17)). To close this loophole, [§4 of the original 2023 MeetEval paper (printed pp. 29–30)](https://www.isca-archive.org/chime_2023/neumann23_chime.pdf) introduced Time-Constrained minimum-Permutation Word Error Rate (tcpWER), stipulating that a reference word and hypothesis word may be matched as correct or substituted only if their time intervals overlap within a prescribed tolerance (`collar`). Whenever time-constrained metrics are used, one must document whether word-level timestamps come from manual annotation, forced alignment, or character-proportional interpolation, and verify whether intervals touching at a single endpoint count as overlapping.

When reading public challenge leaderboards, always verify aggregation denominators and scoring protocol details first. Within the same CHiME-8 Challenge, for example, the [Task 1 (DASR) submission protocol](https://www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime8/task1/submission) adopts tcpWER with a $5\ \mathrm{s}$ collar, and its [official scoring toolkit `chime-utils`](https://github.com/chimechallenge/chime-utils) pools total word errors and total reference words within each scenario before taking an unweighted arithmetic mean across the four scenarios; whereas [Task 2 (NOTSOFAR) rules](https://www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime8/task2/rules), while also using a $5\ \mathrm{s}$ collar, compute tcpWER per session on the [official leaderboard](https://www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime8/task2/results) before taking an unweighted mean across sessions, alongside reporting speaker-agnostic tcORC-WER for diagnostic reference. Cross-edition comparisons require even greater caution: [CHiME-9](https://www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime9/), for instance, pivoted to MCoRec and the conversational hearing-aid enhancement task ECHI, changing datasets, channel topologies, and evaluation metrics alike—numbers from two editions must never be ranked in a single table.

| **同时重叠人数上限扩展** | 随日志轨道数线性扩展（每人在各自活动窗内独立求波束） | 超过 $3$ 人强重叠时 `<sc>` 序列长度翻倍易出现漏词 | 按检测到的每位活跃说话人分别执行一次条件前向推理 |

工程落地决策准则十分明确：凡是业务场景要求**保留每位发言人的独立估计波形供复核**（如庭审记录、医疗问诊质检、远程视频会议混音转发）或配备了几何标定清晰的 4～8 麦会议阵列，**`TS-VAD + WPE + GSS + 单人 ASR`** 是便于逐模块诊断的候选方案，其性能须按实际日志、混响与识别条件验证；反之，若硬件仅有单麦克风或双麦手机录音、不需要导出分离音频且追求端侧紧凑部署，则 `SOT` 或 `DiCoW` 能够规避单麦波形分离引入的非线性伪影（Musical / Neural Artifacts），消除分离器与后端 ASR 之间的声学失配。
4. **下游消费的是“可听波形”还是“纯文本”？** 需要人工复听录音或对接冻结的商用黑盒 ASR 接口时，优先采用 `TS-VAD + GSS` 线性空间波束链路以便检查独立波形、掩码与空间滤波误差；线性波束形成也不保证零伪影；算力受限且仅需最终文字流时，可评估分块 `SOT` 或 `DiCoW` 条件转写方案。

| **Per-module debugging and upgradeability** | **Excellent** (auditing GSS waveforms immediately isolates diarization misses from ASR word errors) | Difficult (separation and language decoding are entangled inside a single black-box decoder) | Moderate (diarization frame masks are inspectable and tunable; recognition reuses pretrained backbone) |

| **Scalability to simultaneous overlap count** | Scales linearly with diarization track count (each talker beamformed independently over their active window) | Beyond $3$ heavily overlapping talkers, doubled `<sc>` sequence length suffers word deletions | Executes one conditioned forward pass per detected active talker |

3. **声卡 DMA 块周期与算法帧移的公倍数拼接缓冲，以及历史状态不计前瞻**：若底层音频驱动按 $B_{\mathrm{io}}=160$ 点（$10\ \mathrm{ms}$）的中断周期搬运样本，而频域前端按 $H=128$ 点（$8\ \mathrm{ms}$）步进，两者块长不整除，中间环形缓冲就会出现周期性余量等待（见练习 [E10-08](#e10-08) 的逐回调余量推演）；将驱动 DMA 周期设为 $128$ 点（$8\ \mathrm{ms}$）与帧移严格对齐，每次回调到达即可触发一次频域帧处理，省去跨块凑帧等待。同时，在线先预测后更新的 WPE、递归协方差平滑、卡尔曼追踪状态与因果 AGC 的平滑记忆全都只读取过去帧，属于历史状态，绝不能当成未来前瞻加进延迟账本。

实时音频驱动（如跨平台的 PortAudio、macOS/iOS 的 Core Audio、Windows 的 WASAPI 或嵌入式 DMA 中断服务例程）以严格的硬件时钟节拍触发回调。声卡回调线程的核心准则是在本周期截止期（deadline）前完成样本搬运并返回：凡是在回调内部执行动态堆内存分配（`malloc`/`new`）、争用阻塞式互斥锁（`mutex`）、读写磁盘文件、格式化打印日志或调用耗时波动的神经网络推理，都可能引发优先级反转或无界阻塞，导致硬件缓冲区断流（参见 [PortAudio 官方实时回调编写规范](https://portaudio.com/docs/v19-doxydocs/writing_a_callback.html)）。

在裸机微控制器或实时操作系统（RTOS）驱动的嵌入式音频 DSP（如 ARM Cortex-M7、Cortex-A 或 Cadence HiFi DSP）上，物理样本搬运通常采用 **DMA 乒乓双缓冲（Ping-Pong Double Buffering）**：将一块两倍于单帧周期的连续环形内存划为前半块（Ping）与后半块（Pong），当 DMA 硬件写满前半块触发半传输中断（Half-Transfer IRQ）时，硬件立即无缝转去填充后半块，DSP 线程则安全读取刚填好的前半块；满传输中断（Transfer-Complete IRQ）再触发角色互换，实现零拷贝、无撕裂流水线。此时必须严防**写回式（Write-Back）L1/L2 数据缓存一致性陷阱**：
- **采集通路（RX）**：DMA 直接把新样本写入片上 SRAM 或外部 DDR，并不会自动刷新 CPU 数据缓存；若 DSP 在读取新到的乒乓半块前未执行**缓存失效（Cache Invalidate）**，CPU 读出来的仍是上一帧残留的陈旧缓存行，表现为诡异的周期性“卡带”或随机噪声；
| Buffering | Driver, Direct Memory Access (DMA), network, or frame-assembly waits | Audio callback period, jitter buffers, full-chunk inference |

3. **DMA block-period mismatch buffering and strictly causal history states**: If the audio driver delivers $B_{\mathrm{io}}=160$-sample ($10\ \mathrm{ms}$) interrupts while the frequency-domain front end steps by $H=128$ samples ($8\ \mathrm{ms}$), non-divisible block sizes induce periodic remainder waits in the intermediate ring buffer (traced callback-by-callback in Exercise [E10-08](#e10-08)); aligning DMA period directly to $128$ samples ($8\ \mathrm{ms}$) triggers exactly one STFT frame per callback with zero cross-block assembly wait. Likewise, causal predict-then-update WPE, recursive covariance smoothing, Kalman tracker states, and causal AGC states read strictly past frames and never add future lookahead latency.

Real-time audio backends (cross-platform PortAudio, macOS/iOS Core Audio, Windows WASAPI, or embedded DMA ISRs) fire callbacks on strict hardware clock ticks. One strict rule governs the audio callback thread: finish sample transport and return before the period deadline. Dynamic heap allocation (`malloc`/`new`), blocking mutex contention, disk file I/O, formatted logging, or variable-latency neural inference inside a callback risks priority inversion and unbounded stalls, starving hardware buffers (see the [official PortAudio real-time callback guidelines](https://portaudio.com/docs/v19-doxydocs/writing_a_callback.html)).

On bare-metal microcontrollers or RTOS-driven embedded audio DSPs (e.g., ARM Cortex-M7, Cortex-A, or Cadence HiFi DSPs), physical sample transport typically uses **DMA Ping-Pong Double Buffering**: a contiguous circular memory region sized to twice one frame period is split into a first half (Ping) and second half (Pong). When the DMA engine fills the first half and triggers a Half-Transfer IRQ, hardware seamlessly switches to filling the second half while the DSP safely reads the completed first half; the Transfer-Complete IRQ then swaps roles for a zero-copy, tear-free pipeline. Guard strictly against **write-back L1/L2 data cache coherency traps**:

- **Capture path (RX)**: DMA writes fresh samples directly into on-chip SRAM or external DDR without automatically refreshing the CPU data cache; if the DSP does not perform a **Cache Invalidate** before reading the newly arrived Ping/Pong half, the CPU reads stale cache lines from the previous frame, manifesting as baffling periodic stuttering or random noise;

locator_hits_first5.text: 同时，单级大倍数 CIC 在通带边缘存在显著滚降：当 $f_s=16\ \mathrm{kHz}$、$R=64$、$M=1$（即 $f_{\mathrm{PDM}}=1.024\ \mathrm{MHz}$）时，在 $f=7\ \mathrm{kHz}$ 处，精确离散单阶增益为 $\sin(7\pi/16)/[64\sin(7\pi/1024)]\approx 0.7136$，单阶衰减 $-2.930\ \mathrm{dB}$，四阶 $\mathrm{Sinc}^4$ 累积滚降高达 **$-11.72\ \mathrm{dB}$**。因此工业 PDM 接口在 CIC 降到 $2f_s$ 或 $4f_s$（如 $3.072\ \mathrm{MHz}$ 下首级 $R_1=16$ 在 $7\ \mathrm{kHz}$ 处四阶滚降仅 $-0.0757\ \mathrm{dB}$、群延迟 $\tau_g=9.766\ \mu\mathrm{s}$）后，通常串联补偿低通 FIR 托平高频通带并抑制抽取混叠；直流偏置须由独立去直流环节处理，单位直流增益低通不能消除直流。

Meanwhile, single-stage high-$R$ CICs suffer steep passband droop: at $f_s=16\ \mathrm{kHz}, R=64, M=1$ ($f_{\mathrm{PDM}}=1.024\ \mathrm{MHz}$), $f=7\ \mathrm{kHz}$ has exact discrete single-stage gain $\sin(7\pi/16)/[64\sin(7\pi/1024)]\approx 0.7136$ ($-2.930\ \mathrm{dB}$), compounding across $\mathrm{Sinc}^4$ to **$-11.72\ \mathrm{dB}$**. Industrial PDM peripherals therefore decimate to $2f_s$ or $4f_s$ first (e.g., at $3.072\ \mathrm{MHz}$, first-stage $R_1=16$ droops just $-0.0757\ \mathrm{dB}$ at $7\ \mathrm{kHz}$ with group delay $\tau_g=9.766\ \mu\mathrm{s}$) before cascading half-band droop-compensation FIRs and DC-blocking filters.

locator_hits_first5.text: 转换器的滤波等待也应按型号、采样率、模式及频带计入。例如 [TI TLV320ADC6140 数据手册](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tlv320adc6140.pdf)的表26、34、40在 $48/44.1\ \mathrm{kHz}$ 档分别给出线性相位模式群延迟 $17.1/f_s$，低延迟与超低延迟模式分别为 $7.7/f_s$、$4.1/f_s$；三者所列群延迟规格的适用频带上限分别为 $0.454f_s$、$0.365f_s$、$0.325f_s$，后两者另有群延迟起伏。播放侧须另核 DAC，例如 [PCM510xA](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/pcm5102a.pdf)的低延迟滤波表7给出 $3.5/f_s$。这些是各滤波模式的规格，不能合成一个适用于所有 ADC/DAC 的采样点数，更不能直接当作整机环回延迟。

**真机环回与驱动时间戳对照实测（MacBook Air）。** 为直观验证驱动回调时间戳与真实声学环回偏移之间的对应关系，本书在 MacBook Air（`Mac17,3`）上通过 Core Audio 与 PortAudio 打开 $48\ \mathrm{kHz}$ 全双工流（内置单麦采集、内置双扬声器外放同一扫频脉冲，脚本与原始日志归档于 [`macbook_audio_latency` 复跑说明](../codes/chapters/ch10/examples/macbook_audio_latency/README.md)），分别实测了两条物理方向相反的延迟指标：

左列声学间隔比右列驱动时间戳估计大约 $92\ \mathrm{ms}$，这是两种测量口径的偏差，尚不能单独归因为声程或某一缓冲。软件缓冲从 $60$ 改为 $100\ \mathrm{ms}$ 时，两列均增加约 $40\ \mathrm{ms}$，支持增量记账一致；任意固定偏差在相减中都会抵消，因此不能据此证明绝对延迟已校准。原始四流共 $15\,314$ 次回调零 `xrun` 的记录保留（配对算术见 [E10-17](#e10-17)）。

为了直观展示失同步对多通道合成的破坏，图 35 与主音频清单的 `clock_drift` 组构造了一组标称 $16\ \mathrm{kHz}$、设备时钟偏快 $100\ \mathrm{ppm}$、总长 $8\ \mathrm{s}$ 的确定性多频合成算例：两台虚拟设备在各自真实的物理采样时刻对同一连续声波函数精确取值（绝不用双声道音量平移假冒时钟漂移）。以 $8\ \mathrm{s}$ 参考标称位置换算，偏快设备的同序号采样发生在 $8/(1+10^{-4})\ \mathrm{s}$，两者时差已累积至约 $0.79992\ \mathrm{ms}$，折合 $12.799$ 个参考采样周期（各 WAV 文件的精确样本数与导出增益见[主音频清单](../codes/chapters/ch00/audio/MANIFEST.json)）。

- **`libsoxr`（`soxr_set_io_ratio`）的比例反转注意**：切换到 `libsoxr` 时，其可变比率接口定义的却是**“输入采样率 / 输出采样率”**（见 [`libsoxr` 官方变比率示例 `5-variable-rate.c`](https://sourceforge.net/p/soxr/code/ci/945b592b70470e29f917f4de89b4281fbbd540c0/tree/examples/5-variable-rate.c)），同一个偏快 $100\ \mathrm{ppm}$ 的输入必须传入 $1.0001$ 而非 $0.99990001$，若按习惯传反就会让漂移加倍恶化。在配套 `libsoxr 0.1.3` 变比率测试（$48\ \mathrm{kHz}\to 16\ \mathrm{kHz}$，中途由 $+100\ \mathrm{ppm}$ 切换至 $+150\ \mathrm{ppm}$）中，在线更新比率并执行尾部排空后，扣除固定 $2$ 帧群延迟偏移的残余漂移归零，且流式分块与整段处理逐点一致（逐帧消费计数与过渡斜坡幅差详见 [`libsoxr` 比率渐变与输出延迟实验说明](../codes/chapters/ch00/research/03_industrial_deployment.md#i22libsoxr-的比率渐变与输出延迟)）。

Account for converter filters by device, rate, mode, and band. For example, the [TI TLV320ADC6140 datasheet](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tlv320adc6140.pdf) lists group delays $17.1/f_s$, $7.7/f_s$, and $4.1/f_s$ in its linear-phase, low-latency, and ultra-low-latency modes at the $48/44.1\ \mathrm{kHz}$ rate family (Tables 26, 34, and 40). The upper frequencies of their listed group-delay specifications are $0.454f_s$, $0.365f_s$, and $0.325f_s$, respectively; the latter two also specify group-delay variation. Check the playback DAC separately: for example, the [PCM510xA](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/pcm5102a.pdf) low-latency filter Table 7 lists $3.5/f_s$. These filter specifications are not a universal ADC/DAC sample count or a complete device-loopback delay.

**Real-hardware loopback and driver-timestamp benchmark (MacBook Air).** To verify the relationship between audio callback timestamps and physical acoustic loopback offsets directly on real hardware, we opened a $48\ \mathrm{kHz}$ full-duplex Core Audio + PortAudio stream on a MacBook Air (`Mac17,3`, built-in mono mic capturing the same chirp played through built-in stereo speakers; scripts and raw logs archived in [`macbook_audio_latency/README.md`](../codes/chapters/ch10/examples/macbook_audio_latency/README.md)) and measured two opposite physical paths:

The two measurement definitions differ by about $92\ \mathrm{ms}$; this alone does not isolate acoustic propagation or a particular buffer. Increasing the software buffer from $60$ to $100\ \mathrm{ms}$ increases both estimates by about $40\ \mathrm{ms}$, supporting incremental timestamp accounting. Any fixed bias cancels in that difference, so it does not establish absolute calibration. The original four-stream record of $15{,}314$ callbacks and zero `xrun`s is retained (see [E10-17](#e10-17)).

First principle of audio hardware architecture: **never go asynchronous when a shared clock is possible**. Drive all ADCs and loopback DACs inside an enclosure from a single master clock (`MCLK`/`BCLK`), and enable hardware clock locking on networked pro-audio gear; reserve software "online SRO estimation $\to$ fractional-delay asynchronous SRC $\to$ closed-loop thermal drift tracking" strictly for genuinely clock-independent consumer devices.

Figure 35 and the `clock_drift` group in the master audio manifest construct a deterministic $8\ \mathrm{s}$, nominal-$16\ \mathrm{kHz}$ two-device benchmark with $+100\ \mathrm{ppm}$ device clock offset, evaluating the exact same continuous acoustic waveform at each device's true physical sampling instants (never approximating drift via stereo panning). At nominal $8\ \mathrm{s}$, the faster device captures its matching sample index at $8/(1+10^{-4})\ \mathrm{s}$, accumulating $\approx 0.79992\ \mathrm{ms}$ ($12.799$ reference samples; exact lengths and gains in the [master manifest](../codes/chapters/ch00/audio/MANIFEST.json)).

## 10. Engineering Implementation, Evaluation, and Industrial Practice

Chapters 1–9 examined the principles and algorithms of sound source localization, beamforming, acoustic echo cancellation, dereverberation, speech separation, and source tracking individually. When these modules enter commercial hardware products, end-user experience is governed above all by system-level coupling: in what causal order modules cascade or run in parallel, at which tap point playback references and control states are extracted, how sampling-clock offsets and audio driver buffers erode inter-channel phase and real-time deadlines, how fixed-point word lengths and battery budgets are allocated, and how to build an acceptance suite immune to gaming any single metric. This chapter walks through that complete engineering closed loop; all accompanying mathematically synthesized WAVs and teaching scripts verify arithmetic contracts, timing semantics, and failure boundaries reproducibly, while full-device acoustic and real-time performance must always be validated on target hardware.

> ⚠️ 本篇是本书正文第 14 章（扩展专题Ⅲ；正文共 16 章，即第 0～15 章，其中第 12～15 章为四篇扩展专题，另有附录 A、B），接在第 13 章分布式麦克风协同增强之后，系统介绍三维空间声场采集、参数化空间编码与可穿戴麦克风阵列处理。三维旋转群 $\mathrm{SO}(3)$、Wirtinger 复梯度与球面调和函数推导见[第 0 章 §0.1](00_math-foundations.md#sec-0-1)、[§0.5](00_math-foundations.md#sec-0-5)与[§0.7](00_math-foundations.md#sec-0-7)，全局符号速查见[第 16 章附录 A](16_appendix-symbols-math.md)。
> 首页导读：[00_overview.md](00_overview.md) ｜ 上一篇：[13_distributed-enhancement.md](13_distributed-enhancement.md) ｜ 下一篇：[15_target-extraction-diarization.md](15_target-extraction-diarization.md)

第一个转变是**输出不再是一路抹平方向的单声道信号，而是携带完整三维方向感与环境包围感的声场或双耳声压**。无论是用紧凑的四胶囊四面体麦克风采集三维一阶全景声（First-Order Ambisonics，FOA），还是用智能眼镜框上的多支微型麦克风合成佩戴者双耳鼓膜处的声学传递响应，系统都必须在保留精确双耳时间差（Interaural Time Difference，ITD）、双耳声级差（Interaural Level Difference，ILD）和环境扩散感的同时完成空间滤波。当佩戴者转动头部时，渲染出的虚拟声像还必须反方向平滑旋转，才能让声源稳稳锚定在真实物理世界中。
| 紧凑全景声采集 | 正四面体 $4$ 胶囊球阵 | 正交球谐通道与参数化声场流 | 高频空间混叠、开球径向零陷与多源干涉偏置 |
上表展示了四类典型系统的硬件边界与任务差异。尽管它们的产品形态各异，底层却共享同一套声压—质点振速波动关系、受限孔径空间匹配优化与多传感器二阶统计融合准则。本章便沿着“三维声场球谐表示 $\to$ 声强参数化分析 $\to$ 可穿戴双耳匹配与相干度保持 $\to$ 抗风噪跨模态自语音融合与百微秒以内超低延迟通透重放”的脉络逐层展开。

The preceding ten chapters sequentially unpacked the physical propagation models of microphone arrays, array geometry, direction-of-arrival estimation, beamforming, acoustic echo cancellation, dereverberation, speech separation, source tracking, and device-level system integration. Yet when an actual engineering project reaches the scoping stage, the most common mistake is putting the cart before the horse: stuffing a string of fashionable modules into a block diagram before clearly specifying what signal the system must ultimately deliver and what hard boundaries constrain it. When the exact same four-microphone array is mounted inside a fixed desktop agent speakerphone, a large multi-participant conference room terminal, or a mobile service robot, the acoustic boundary conditions and real-time constraints differ drastically—and the appropriate front-end processing chain diverges accordingly. Following the progression "clarify task constraints $\rightarrow$ select geometry and algorithmic modules by physical conditions $\rightarrow$ establish multi-metric statistical acceptance specifications," this chapter consolidates the knowledge of the entire book into a reproducible, falsifiable selection methodology.

locator_hits_first5.text: **输入与口径**：按真实说话人拼接得到 $R_{\text{甲}} =$“春天 秋天”与 $R_{\text{乙}} =$“夏天 冬天”，参考总词数 $N_{\mathrm{ref}} = 4$；两条匿名输出流拼接后分别为 $H_1 =$“春天 冬天”与 $H_2 =$“夏天 秋天”。为了在同一算例上同时核对 sa-WER，再考虑一种典型的声纹注册事故——会前录入声纹库时，工作人员不慎把甲、乙两人的注册声纹档案录反了：于是无论甲的声音落在第 1 段的流 1 还是第 2 段的流 2，下游声纹检索模块都稳定地将其标成“乙”，而把乙的声音（“夏天”与“冬天”）统统标成“甲”。

我们用一个三维坐标手算算例来直观验证“几何不可辨识性无法靠算法弥补”。沿用第 2 章远场平面波单位入射方向与导向相位约定，将三只共面麦克风置于 $xy$ 平面上的 $\vec p_1 = (0,0,0)^\top$、$\vec p_2 = (0.04,0,0)^\top$ 与 $\vec p_3 = (0,0.04,0)^\top\ \mathrm{m}$，考察上下镜像对称的两个单位方向向量 $\vec u_+ = (0.6, 0, 0.8)^\top$ 与 $\vec u_- = (0.6, 0, -0.8)^\top$（满足 $\|\vec u_\pm\|_2 = \sqrt{0.6^2 + 0^2 + (\pm 0.8)^2} = 1$）。

以第 1 麦为相位参考点，其余两麦相对参考点的空间程差投影分别为内积 $\vec p_2^\top \vec u_\pm = 0.024\ \mathrm{m}$（即 $0.04\times 0.6 + 0 + 0$）与 $\vec p_3^\top \vec u_\pm = 0\ \mathrm{m}$。由于两只麦克风的 $z$ 坐标全为零，$\pm 0.8$ 的垂直分量在点乘中被彻底抹零——这意味着在任意频率 $f$ 下，$\vec u_+$ 与 $\vec u_-$ 产生的理想阵列流形导向矢量逐分量完全恒等。无论把快拍数拉到无穷大，还是把 GCC-PHAT 换成 MUSIC、MVDR 乃至深度网络，仅凭这三路理想自由场观测在信息论意义上都无法区分声源来自阵面上方还是下方。
此外，碰撞事故后的紧急救援呼叫（eCall）遵循 **P.1140**，要求在气囊爆开或车窗破碎等极端畸变工况下仍保住公共安全应答点的可懂度底线；而把前排语音实时扩声给后排乘客的**车载座舱通话增强（ICC）**则由 **P.1150** 专门规范，重点考核闭环啸叫稳定裕度、听音费力程度、空间定位保持及强化延迟上限。

反之，一旦引入蓝牙免提手机、USB 外挂记录仪或跨独立晶振电子控制单元（ECU）的以太网流，不同时钟域之间就会出现数十至上百 ppm 的相对 SRO 与包抖动：设快时钟采样率为 $f_s(1+\varepsilon)$、慢时钟为 $f_s$，在慢时钟时刻 $T = n/f_s$ 处同索引第 $n$ 点的精确物理时差为 $\Delta t = \varepsilon T/(1+\varepsilon)$（百 ppm 下常近似为 $\varepsilon T$）；若每次重对齐仍留有初始残差 $b$ 且频偏上界为 $\varepsilon_{\max}$，则维持总错位不超过 $B$ 的最坏周期必须严守 $T \le (B - b)(1+\varepsilon_{\max})/\varepsilon_{\max}$（例如 $B = 100\ \mu\mathrm{s}$、$b = 20\ \mu\mathrm{s}$、$\varepsilon_{\max} = 90\ \mathrm{ppm}$ 时，周期由无残差 $80\ \mathrm{ppm}$ 下的 $1.25\ \mathrm{s}$ 急缩至约 $0.89\ \mathrm{s}$）。此时若直接套用跨节点 MVDR 或固定多通道回声滤波器，数秒内的微秒级采样漂移便会令空间零陷与回声对消彻底失效（见章末 [E11-01](#e11-01)、[E11-07](#e11-07) 与 [E11-21](#e11-21)），必须在选型首环插入硬件时间戳捕获与在线异步采样率转换（ASRC）。

Let us verify via a concrete three-dimensional coordinate hand calculation that "geometric unidentifiability cannot be rescued by algorithms." Following Chapter 2's far-field plane-wave unit incident vector and steering-phase convention, place three coplanar microphones in the $xy$-plane at $\vec p_1 = (0,0,0)^\top$, $\vec p_2 = (0.04,0,0)^\top$, and $\vec p_3 = (0,0.04,0)^\top\ \mathrm{m}$, and examine two mirror-symmetric unit direction vectors above and below the plane: $\vec u_+ = (0.6, 0, 0.8)^\top$ and $\vec u_- = (0.6, 0, -0.8)^\top$ (satisfying $\|\vec u_\pm\|_2 = \sqrt{0.6^2 + 0^2 + (\pm 0.8)^2} = 1$).

Taking Microphone 1 as the phase reference, the spatial path-difference projections of the other two microphones relative to the reference are the inner products $\vec p_2^\top \vec u_\pm = 0.024\ \mathrm{m}$ (i.e., $0.04\times 0.6 + 0 + 0$) and $\vec p_3^\top \vec u_\pm = 0\ \mathrm{m}$. Because the $z$-coordinates of all three microphones are identically zero, the vertical component $\pm 0.8$ is wiped out completely in every dot product—meaning that at *every* frequency $f$, the ideal array-manifold steering vectors generated by $\vec u_+$ and $\vec u_-$ are entry-wise identical. Whether one extends snapshot count to infinity or swaps GCC-PHAT for MUSIC, MVDR, or a deep neural network, these three ideal free-field observations are information-theoretically incapable of distinguishing whether the source lies above or below the array plane.

Conversely, once Bluetooth hands-free phones, USB dashcams, or Ethernet streams crossing Electronic Control Units (ECUs) with independent crystal oscillators enter the loop, relative SROs of tens to hundreds of ppm plus packet jitter arise between clock domains: letting the fast clock run at $f_s(1+\varepsilon)$ and the slow clock at $f_s$, at slow-clock time $T = n/f_s$ the exact physical time difference at identical sample index $n$ is $\Delta t = \varepsilon T/(1+\varepsilon)$ (often approximated by $\varepsilon T$ at the hundred-ppm scale); if each re-alignment leaves an initial residual $b$ and frequency offset is bounded above by $\varepsilon_{\max}$, keeping total skew within $B$ enforces a worst-case re-alignment period $T \le (B - b)(1+\varepsilon_{\max})/\varepsilon_{\max}$ (for example, at $B = 100\ \mu\mathrm{s}$, $b = 20\ \mu\mathrm{s}$, and $\varepsilon_{\max} = 90\ \mathrm{ppm}$, the period shrinks sharply from $1.25\ \mathrm{s}$ at residual-free $80\ \mathrm{ppm}$ to roughly $0.89\ \mathrm{s}$). Applying cross-node MVDR or fixed multi-channel echo filters directly under such conditions sees microsecond-level sample drift destroy spatial nulls and echo cancellation within seconds (see Exercises [E11-01](#e11-01), [E11-07](#e11-07), and [E11-21](#e11-21)), making hardware timestamp capture and online Asynchronous Sample Rate Conversion (ASRC) mandatory at the very front of the pipeline.

When adopting open-source packages, record the canonical repository URL, pinned commit hash or release tag, software license, supported platforms, I/O interface contracts, maintenance status, and minimal regression tests directly inside the specification (see §10.8.1).

Passing unit tests on a pedagogical baseline proves that mathematical conventions and degenerate boundary cases match theory, without substituting for target-device engineering acceptance; when advancing toward mass production, concrete open-source toolchains, peripheral resampling/I/O/objective-scoring interface semantics, and embedded runtime selection are detailed in [Chapter 10, §10.5](10_engineering-practice.md#sec-10-5), [§10.8](10_engineering-practice.md#sec-10-8), and [Industrial Deployment Research](../codes/chapters/ch00/research_en/03_industrial_deployment.md), while this chapter focuses on formulating those preconditions as falsifiable acceptance rules and statistical gates.

- **Hearing-device regulatory scope and path gains**: The verified 2025 edition of FDA 21 CFR 800.30 applies to its defined OTC air-conduction hearing aids, not universally to all medical hearing instruments. Output, noise, distortion, and latency limits require the specified signals, bands, and measurement methods. ANSI/CTA-2051 and IEC 60601-2-66 also have distinct scopes and cannot be combined into one statutory ceiling. Next, examine the two-path interference mechanism in the second and third lines: whenever $\cos(2\pi f\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}})=-1$, airborne direct sound and loudspeaker reinforcement interfere destructively at regular frequency intervals $\Delta f = 1/\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}}$, carving a dense comb-filter notch sequence $f_m$. Copying a conventional $32\ \mathrm{ms}$-frame, $16\ \mathrm{ms}$-hop STFT enhancer or a neural separator with tens of milliseconds of lookahead into an ICC path pushes algorithmic buffering alone to $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}} \ge 22\text{–}25\ \mathrm{ms}$, digging notches over ten decibels deep every $40\text{–}45\ \mathrm{Hz}$ across the core $300\text{–}3400\ \mathrm{Hz}$ speech band (nearly 70 notches in total)—producing harsh metallic "hollow barrel" coloration and shattering forward auditory image fusion under the Haas precedence effect.

locator_hits_first5.text: 不带时间约束的编辑距离还会引入另一重隐患：在长达数十分钟的会议录音里，“好”“对”“是的”等高频词反复出现，普通动态规划会把第 1 秒漏掉的参考词拿去与第 10 分钟误插入的同词配成“零错误”（见 [E11-17](#e11-17)）。为此，[MeetEval 2023 原论文 §4（印刷第 29～30 页）](https://www.isca-archive.org/chime_2023/neumann23_chime.pdf)引入了时间约束最小排列词错误率（Time-Constrained minimum-Permutation Word Error Rate，tcpWER），规定只有当参考词与假设词的时间区间在预定容差（collar）内发生重叠时，才允许作正确匹配或替换。使用时间约束指标时，必须同步写明词级时间戳来自人工标注、强制对齐还是按字符长度比例近似，并核对端点刚好相接时算不算重叠。
#### E11-17：同一个词在错误时刻出现，词错误还能为零吗

Unconstrained edit distance without timing introduces a second pitfall: in tens-of-minutes-long meeting recordings where high-frequency backchannels such as "okay," "right," and "yes" recur constantly, standard dynamic programming will pair a reference word missed at $1\ \mathrm{s}$ with an identical word spuriously inserted at $10\ \mathrm{min}$ for "zero error" (see [E11-17](#e11-17)). To close this loophole, [§4 of the original 2023 MeetEval paper (printed pp. 29–30)](https://www.isca-archive.org/chime_2023/neumann23_chime.pdf) introduced Time-Constrained minimum-Permutation Word Error Rate (tcpWER), stipulating that a reference word and hypothesis word may be matched as correct or substituted only if their time intervals overlap within a prescribed tolerance (`collar`). Whenever time-constrained metrics are used, one must document whether word-level timestamps come from manual annotation, forced alignment, or character-proportional interpolation, and verify whether intervals touching at a single endpoint count as overlapping.
#### E11-17: When the Right Word Appears at the Wrong Time, Can WER Still Be Zero?

普通词编辑距离只比较词序。如果参考“春天”的区间为 `[0,1]` 秒，假设同词却在 `[10,11]` 秒，普通错误数为0；下面实际运行的固定时间核只能删除并插入，错误数为2。正重叠区间 `[0,1]` 与 `[0.5,1.5]` 则可以匹配，错误数为0。[E11-17](../../../../chapters/11_selection-guide.md#e11-17)说明词时间、容差与内容评分的关系；词元是预先分好的整个词，不把“春天”自动拆成两个汉字。

这些是近似时间，不能称为从波形得到的真实词边界。[作者2025原稿v1 §V-C](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.02112v1)说明假设用中点是为了避免扩大词区间来改善匹配；字符数比例也不保证等于中文词的发音时长。本书[E11-17](../../../../chapters/11_selection-guide.md#e11-17)教学核只接受正时长区间，这是有限接口条件，不是原核不能处理点。[作者2023原文 §4.2，印刷第30页](https://www.isca-archive.org/chime_2023/neumann23_chime.pdf)的容差选择依赖当时数据与标注误差；不把该实验的5 s当成所有数据集的默认正确值。

Reading Sections IV-F, V-A Eq. (10), VI-A, and VII Algorithm 1 of the authors' follow-up manuscript [*Word Error Rate Definitions and Algorithms for Long-Form Multi-talker Speech Recognition* (2025, v1)](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.02112v1) (supplemental verification 2026-10-02) reinforces three rules: (1) reference utterance boundaries are fixed evaluation inputs ([Exercise E11-16](../../../../chapters_en/11_selection-guide.md#e11-16)); (2) DI-cpWER is a diagnostic tool rather than a primary leaderboard metric because re-segmenting hypotheses alters assignment degrees of freedom; and (3) standard Levenshtein ignores timestamps completely—matching reference word `"spring"` on `[0, 1]` s against hypothesis `"spring"` at `[10, 11]` s with `0` errors, whereas **time-constrained Levenshtein** rejects disjoint intervals (`1` deletion + `1` insertion = `2` errors) while matching overlapping `[0, 1]` s and `[0.5, 1.5]` s with `0` errors ([Exercise E11-17](../../../../chapters_en/11_selection-guide.md#e11-17), operating on pre-tokenized whole words).
