locator_hits_first5.text: 第一对是**数字域波形相减（AEC）与空气声场物理相消（ANC / 车载 ICC）的本质分野**。AEC 在数字处理器内部用麦克风采样 $d[n]$ 减去估计副本 $\hat y[n]$，目的是阻止本机播放声传回远端通话方，房间里的本地人耳依然听得到扬声器外放；只要副本相位误差超过 $60^\circ$，复数减法甚至可能令残余能量反超原回声（见练习 [E06-04](#e06-04)）。相比之下，主动噪声控制（Active Noise Control，ANC）通过次级扬声器向空气辐射反相声波，电子控制时延须严格小于主次声路飞行时差（常为亚毫秒级）；车载座舱通话增强（In-Car Communication，ICC）则将前排语音拾取放大后经后排扬声器实时播放在空气中与直达声物理叠加，**ITU-T P.1150** 要求监听位置的强化首波相对自然直达首波的到达差受限（$\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}}<15\ \mathrm{ms}$），而入耳式耳机通透模式（Hear-Through）的鼓膜叠加延迟上限更收紧至百微秒级（详见[第 14 章 §14.10](14_spatial-wearable-arrays.md#sec-14-10)）。这类在空气中直接进入人耳的物理叠加干涉无法靠发送端数字 AEC 事后抹除，三类环路的梳状滤波频响与定量时延预算对比见 §6.7.1 与练习 [E06-30](#e06-30) 第 2 问。

- **同舱本地扩声与主动降噪的物理声波叠加边界（车载 ICC vs ANC）**：车载座舱通话增强（ICC）将前排语音实时放大后由后排扬声器播出，声波在空气中与直达声 $s(t)+\alpha s(t-\tau_{\mathrm{loop}})$ 发生物理声压叠加，功率谱 $|1+\alpha e^{-\mathrm{j}2\pi f\tau_{\mathrm{loop}}}|^2$ 每隔 $\Delta f=1/\tau_{\mathrm{loop}}$ 产生周期性梳状陷波——一旦监听位置的强化首波与自然直达首波之差 $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}}$ 逼近或超过 **ITU-T P.1150** 规定的 $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}}<15\ \mathrm{ms}$ 上限，会加重可闻的延迟与音染风险；是否啸叫还取决于闭环增益和相位；而耳机/座舱主动噪声控制（ANC）更要求电子时延 $\tau_{\mathrm{elec}}\le\tau_{\mathrm{acoust}}-\tau_{\mathrm{sec}}$（常为亚毫秒级）。三类环路的延迟算术对照见练习 [E06-30](#e06-30) 第 2 问。

1. 式(6-1)写作 $d[n]=s[n]+(x*h)[n]+v[n]$：$d[n]$ 为麦克风混合采样，$s[n]$ 为待无损保留的近端人声，$x[n]$ 为已知播放参考，$h[\ell]$ 为等效线性回声路径，$v[n]$ 为环境与电路底噪。AEC 在上行数字链路内减除估计副本 $\hat y[n]$ 以阻止回声传回远端，不会消除本地空气中的外放声波；ANC 与车载 ICC 则涉及空气中真实声波的物理叠加，受声路飞行时间或哈斯融合阈值（如 ITU-T P.1150 的 $15\ \mathrm{ms}$）严格制约（见 §6.1.1）。
2. **物理 ANC 与 ITU-T P.1150 车载 ICC 时延期限**：设声速 $c=343\ \mathrm{m/s}$、$f_s=16\ \mathrm{kHz}$，电声飞行因果不等式与同舱两波梳状陷波公式为：

本题梳状叠加式中的 $\tau_{\mathrm{loop}}$ 指同一监听位置两条首波的到达差 $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}}$，须把自然直达传播时间与强化路径的采集、处理、播放和声传播时间一起计入，不能仅用处理器耗时替代。例如自然直达 $6\ \mathrm{ms}$、强化首波 $20\ \mathrm{ms}$，到达差为 $14\ \mathrm{ms}$。满足该项时差要求并不等于通过完整标准验收。

The first pair is the **fundamental divide between digital waveform subtraction (AEC) and physical sound-field cancellation in air (ANC / in-cabin ICC)**. AEC subtracts the estimated replica $\hat y[n]$ from the microphone samples $d[n]$ inside a digital processor so that local loudspeaker playback is not transmitted back to the far-end caller, while listeners in the local room continue to hear the loudspeaker normally; whenever the replica's phase error exceeds $60^\circ$, complex subtraction can even cause residual energy to exceed the original echo (see Exercise [E06-04](#e06-04)). By contrast, Active Noise Control (ANC) radiates anti-phase acoustic waves into the air via a secondary loudspeaker under strict sub-millisecond acoustic time-of-flight causality; automotive In-Car Communication (ICC) amplifies front-seat speech over rear loudspeakers for physical wave superposition in air under the **ITU-T P.1150** limit on the reinforced first arrival relative to the natural direct first arrival at the listening position ($\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}}<15\ \mathrm{ms}$); and hear-through modes on in-ear headphones tighten eardrum-superposition latency further into the hundred-microsecond regime (see [Chapter 14 §14.10](14_spatial-wearable-arrays.md#sec-14-10)). Physical acoustic interference that has already summed in air before reaching the ear cannot be retroactively erased by a transmit-side digital AEC; the comb-filtering transfer expression and quantitative latency budgets across all three loops are detailed in §6.7.1 and Exercise [E06-30](#e06-30) (Part 2).

- **Physical acoustic wave superposition in local reinforcement and active cancellation (automotive ICC vs. ANC)**: Automotive In-Car Communication (ICC) amplifies front-row speech in real time over rear-row speakers so air-borne waves physically sum as $s(t)+\alpha s(t-\tau_{\mathrm{loop}})$, whose power spectrum $|1+\alpha e^{-\mathrm{j}2\pi f\tau_{\mathrm{loop}}}|^2$ carves periodic comb notches every $\Delta f=1/\tau_{\mathrm{loop}}$—once the reinforced-minus-direct first-arrival difference $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}}$ at the listening position nears or exceeds the **ITU-T P.1150** cap $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}}<15\ \mathrm{ms}$, audible delay and coloration risks increase; howling additionally depends on closed-loop gain and phase; meanwhile headphone/cabin Active Noise Control (ANC) demands electronic delay $\tau_{\mathrm{elec}}\le\tau_{\mathrm{acoust}}-\tau_{\mathrm{sec}}$ (often sub-millisecond). Numerical latency budgets for all three loops are compared in Exercise [E06-30](#e06-30) (Part 2).

1. Equation (6-1) reads $d[n]=s[n]+(x*h)[n]+v[n]$, where $d[n]$ is the microphone mixture, $s[n]$ is near-end speech to preserve intact, $x[n]$ is the known playback reference, $h[\ell]$ is the equivalent linear echo path, and $v[n]$ is ambient and circuit noise. AEC subtracts digital replica $\hat y[n]$ inside the uplink chain to stop echo returning to the far end without canceling room sound in air; ANC and automotive ICC rely on physical wave superposition in air constrained strictly by acoustic time-of-flight or the Haas fusion limit (e.g., $15\ \mathrm{ms}$ in ITU-T P.1150; see §6.1.1).
2. **Physical ANC and ITU-T P.1150 automotive ICC delay budgets**: With $c=343\ \mathrm{m/s}$ and $f_s=16\ \mathrm{kHz}$, the acoustic-causality bound and in-cabin comb-notch spacings are

| 智能座舱 | 4～16+ 麦顶棚与头枕分布阵（A²B 同步总线，零相对 SRO） | 车厢窄空间强反射、$65\text{～}80\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ 路噪/风噪、$-40\text{～}+85\,^\circ\mathrm{C}$ 宽温域 | 车规 DSP/座舱 SoC；音频子系统 $2\text{～}8\ \mathrm{W}$ | ICC $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}} < 15\ \mathrm{ms}$（量产常控 $4\text{～}10\ \mathrm{ms}$）；免提按 P.1110/P.1120 | ITU-T P.1100～P.1150、车规芯片 AEC-Q100 |

- **对标 ITU-T P.1100～P.1150 车载语音标准族**：座舱音频绝非单一指标能概括，立项前须先分清业务归属的标准条款。面向车外蜂窝网的免提通话按传输带宽依次对应 **ITU-T P.1100**（窄带 $300\text{～}3400\ \mathrm{Hz}$）、**P.1110**（宽带 $100\text{～}7000\ \mathrm{Hz}$）与 **P.1120**（超宽带及全频带），重点考核双讲剪切、发送延迟、回声衰减与路噪下的语音质量；模组、数字子系统及短距无线链路的分段验收遵循 **P.1130**。
此外，碰撞事故后的紧急救援呼叫（eCall）遵循 **P.1140**，要求在气囊爆开或车窗破碎等极端畸变工况下仍保住公共安全应答点的可懂度底线；而把前排语音实时扩声给后排乘客的**车载座舱通话增强（ICC）**则由 **P.1150** 专门规范，重点考核闭环啸叫稳定裕度、听音费力程度、空间定位保持及强化延迟上限。

因此 **ITU-T P.1150 强制规定座舱扩声附加延迟 $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}} < 15\ \mathrm{ms}$**（量产工程常严控在 $4\text{～}10\ \mathrm{ms}$），将候选算法严格锁定在时域短抽头 FIR 或超低延迟子带架构之内，一切长窗与前瞻模块均被硬约束直接排除。同时，后排扬声器声波还会经车厢空气路径重新耦合回前排拾音麦构成声学闭环：严格的**巴克豪森（Barkhausen）自激振荡判据**要求闭环幅值 $\ge 0\ \mathrm{dB}$ **且**闭环相位恰好满足 $0^\circ \bmod 360^\circ$；由于包含电子处理链路与车厢回传声程在内的 ICC 闭环总延迟约 $15\text{～}16\ \mathrm{ms}$，使相位每隔约 $62\text{～}67\ \mathrm{Hz}$ 便翻转一周，在语音频带内密集命中数十个零相位点，因此工程上必须对全频带幅值裕度施压，按本题设计预算预留 $\mathrm{GM}_{\min}\ge 6\ \mathrm{dB}$ 的啸叫增益稳定裕度（不等于 P.1150 附录D中另一测点的残余回声/背景差值条件）并据此反推电子扩声增益上限（定量核算见章末 [E11-22](#e11-22)）。
| 2. 半消声标准声场认证 | ETSI TS 103 224 多扬声器背景场 + `3QUEST`、G.122 $\mathrm{TCL}_w$ / P.340 双讲分级、P.1150 延迟与啸叫裕度、OSPL90 硬限幅 | 逐音量档与逐噪声场独立报告区间，严禁池化掩盖最大音量档 | 按式(11-3)三态判定；任一核心条款跨线“证据不足”须补测或整改 |

| Smart automotive cabin | 4–16+ mic headliner & headrest distributed array (A²B synchronous bus, zero relative SRO) | Tight cabin strong reflections, $65\text{–}80\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ road/wind noise, $-40\text{ to }+85\,^\circ\mathrm{C}$ wide temperature range | Automotive-grade DSP / cockpit SoC; audio subsystem $2\text{–}8\ \mathrm{W}$ | ICC $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}} < 15\ \mathrm{ms}$ (production typically $4\text{–}10\ \mathrm{ms}$); hands-free per P.1110/P.1120 | ITU-T P.1100–P.1150, automotive silicon AEC-Q100 |

- **Aligning with the ITU-T P.1100–P.1150 automotive speech standards family**: Cabin audio cannot be summarized by a single number; project scoping must first map each feature to its governing standard clause. Hands-free cellular telephony to external networks maps by transmission bandwidth to **ITU-T P.1100** (narrowband, $300\text{–}3400\ \mathrm{Hz}$), **P.1110** (wideband, $100\text{–}7000\ \mathrm{Hz}$), and **P.1120** (super-wideband and fullband), focusing on double-talk clipping, send delay, echo attenuation, and speech quality under road noise; subsystem, digital module, and short-range wireless link verification follows **P.1130**.

Post-crash emergency calling (eCall) is governed by **P.1140**, which mandates preserving a baseline intelligibility floor for Public Safety Answering Points under extreme cabin acoustic transients such as airbag deployment or shattered windows; meanwhile, **In-Car Communication (ICC)**—real-time reinforcement of front-row speech to rear-row passengers—is governed specifically by **P.1150**, centering on closed-loop howling stability margin, listening effort, spatial localization preservation, and strict reinforcement delay ceilings.

For this reason, **ITU-T P.1150 strictly mandates an excess cabin reinforcement delay of $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}} < 15\ \mathrm{ms}$** (production systems typically hold $4\text{–}10\ \mathrm{ms}$), confining candidate algorithms to short-tap time-domain FIR filters or ultra-low-latency subband architectures and disqualifying all long-window or lookahead modules outright. Simultaneously, rear-loudspeaker sound re-couples through the cabin air path back into front pickup microphones to form a closed acoustic loop: the strict **Barkhausen self-oscillation criterion** requires loop-gain magnitude $\ge 0\ \mathrm{dB}$ **and** loop phase hitting $0^\circ \bmod 360^\circ$; because the closed-loop ICC delay (electronic chain plus cabin return propagation) of roughly $15\text{–}16\ \mathrm{ms}$ wraps phase by $360^\circ$ every $\approx 62\text{–}67\ \mathrm{Hz}$, densely hitting dozens of zero-phase frequencies across the speech band, engineering design must constrain broadband magnitude margin—reserving the example design margin $\mathrm{GM}_{\min}\ge 6\ \mathrm{dB}$ (distinct from the residual-echo/background criterion at another measurement point in P.1150 Annex D) of howling gain margin and back-calculating the maximum permissible electronic reinforcement gain accordingly (see Exercise [E11-22](#e11-22) for quantitative verification).

locator_hits_first5.text: 阅读开源代码时需要留意迭代方向的定义：为消除网格编号顺序带来的方向偏置，Brooks 与 Humphreys 在原论文中明确规定，**完整的一轮 DAMAS 迭代包含正向与反向两次单向遍历**——先从 $1$ 到 $J$ 前向遍历一遍，紧接着从 $J$ 到 $1$ 反向遍历一遍（反向遍历时 $j > i$ 的分量已更新为新值，$j < i$ 的分量尚保持前向遍历结束时的值）。如果教学演示只跑了从 $1$ 到 $J$ 的单程更新，应当准确称为“一次前向遍历”，而不能与原论文的“一轮双向迭代”混为一谈；本书数值核对两种遍历方式分别予以支持和记录。

- **子图 (a) DAMAS 遍历方向与收敛轨迹**：横轴为外层轮数，对数纵轴为两格算例的最大源量误差。在 $J = 2$ 两格特例下，前向遍历结束于更新 $q_2$，反向遍历首步立刻重复更新同一边界分量 $q_2$（幂等不变）后再更新 $q_1$，下一轮前向首步又会重复更新 $q_1$（同样幂等不变）；因此橙色双向曲线与蓝色单向曲线在对数图上呈**严格平行下降**（每轮衰减因子完全相同，均为 $1/16$），橙线仅因第 $1$ 轮多执行了一次有效 $q_1$ 更新而恒定领先半次遍历（误差始终为蓝线的 $1/4$）。只有当网格数 $J \ge 3$ 时，双向对称迭代每轮执行 $2J - 2$ 次有效更新、单向执行 $J$ 次，这表示更新工作量接近两倍，并不保证谱半径或收敛速率改善两倍，评估速度须对齐实际工作量。
#### E12-02：一次双向迭代与一次前向遍历相同吗
**题干。** 从全零初值出发求解式(12-11)，对比单向遍历与原论文双向迭代前两轮的中间数值，并分析在 $J = 2$ 两格算例下两条误差曲线为何在图 63(a) 对数坐标中严格平行。若把方程两侧的 $\mathbf P$ 与 $\vec b$ 同时乘以 $2$，更新公式中忘记除以对角元 $P_{ii}$ 会产生什么后果？最后将非对角耦合元素改为 $0.99$，解释收敛变慢的原因。

**参考答案**：仅做前向单向遍历的前两轮结果已在 §12.5 算出（分别为 $[17/16, 15/64]^\top$ 与 $[257/256, 255/1024]^\top$）。若按原论文执行双向迭代：第 $1$ 轮先完成前向遍历得 $[17/16, 15/64]^\top$，紧接着反向遍历——先更新第 $2$ 格：$1/2 - \frac{1}{4}\times\frac{17}{16} = 15/64$（**边界幂等不变**），再立刻用它更新第 $1$ 格：$17/16 - \frac{1}{4}\times\frac{15}{64} = 257/256$，故双向第 $1$ 轮结束时为 $[257/256, 15/64]^\top$。

One-sided folding factor $\epsilon_k$ equals $2$ at interior positive bins ($1 \le k < N/2$) to fold symmetric negative-frequency energy, and equals $1$ at DC ($k = 0$) and even-$N$ Nyquist ($k = N/2$) where no distinct conjugate partner exists. For pressure-calibrated inputs ($\mathrm{Pa}$), $\mathbf S[k]$ has units $\mathrm{Pa}^2/\mathrm{Hz}$ and $\mathbf R_{\mathrm{bin}}[k]$ has units $\mathrm{Pa}^2$; for uncalibrated digital audio, both carry squared digital full-scale units.

**Step-by-step substitution and intermediate values**: Evaluate the complex spatial response matrix $\mathbf W^H\mathbf A$ first (where $\mathbf W = [\vec w_1, \vec w_2] = \mathbf A / 2$). Using $e^{-\mathrm{j}2\pi/3} = -1/2 - \mathrm{j}\sqrt{3}/2$, the conjugate inner product gives $\vec w_1^H\vec a_2 = \frac{1}{2}(1 + e^{-\mathrm{j}2\pi/3}) = \frac{1}{4} - \mathrm{j}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}$, and symmetrically $\vec w_2^H\vec a_1 = (\vec w_1^H\vec a_2)^* = \frac{1}{4} + \mathrm{j}\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}$:

Avoid two frequent coding bugs here: first, dropping the lower triangle while forgetting to multiply upper-triangular real and imaginary parts by $\sqrt{2}$ cuts all cross-channel phase weights in half (silently altering the objective; see [E12-10](#e12-10)); second, taking `np.real()` on complex $\mathbf H$ and discarding imaginary parts wipes out odd-symmetric phase differences and creates severe mirror-image ghosts.

Running diagonal-removed beamforming for the first time can be unexpected when negative numbers appear in the scan array ("how can acoustic power be negative?"). Two lines of $2 \times 2$ arithmetic explain why: apply anti-phase weight $\vec w = [1/2, -1/2]^\top$ to zero-diagonal symmetric matrix $\mathbf R_{\mathrm{trim}}$ with off-diagonals $1/2$:
Off-diagonals remain conjugate-symmetric while interference splits channel auto-powers into $9/4 = 2.25$ and $3/4 = 0.75$.

SODIX 直接拟合 CSM 并为每对“候选源—麦克风”引入非负辐射幅度，使单一声源不再受同一个标量 $q_j$ 束缚所有通道幅度；由于未知数规模达到 $J \times M$，可用方向与空间平滑改善稳定性，但原方法也允许零正则控制，源位置仍固定在候选网格上（参见 [Funke 等 2014，式(6)～(10)](https://elib.dlr.de/94587/1/BeBeC-2014-11_Funke_SODIX.pdf)）。至于近场声全息（NAH）与相控阵波束成像的物理边界，两者面向截然不同的测试距离与孔径条件：NAH 须将阵列置于距振动物体极近的 $z \ll \lambda$ 处、且阵列孔径通常不小于待测振动表面，以捕获随距离指数衰减的倏逝波并借此突破半波长衍射极限（逆传播时必须借助波数滤波等正则化抑制传感器噪声放大，参见 [Maynard 等 1985，§III](https://doi.org/10.1121/1.392911) 与 Williams 1999）；而相控阵波束成像面向 $z \gtrsim D$ 的中远场行进波，允许以较小孔径远距离扫描大片结构，但常规空间分辨受限于瑞利极限 $\Delta x \sim \lambda z / D$。

SODIX assigns non-negative source-to-microphone radiation amplitudes across all $J \times M$ pairs instead of a single scalar $q_j$, with fixed source-grid positions; directional/spatial smoothing can stabilize the fit but is not mandatory in every original control ([Funke et al. 2014, Eqs. (6)–(10)](https://elib.dlr.de/94587/1/BeBeC-2014-11_Funke_SODIX.pdf)). Nearfield Acoustic Holography (NAH) occupies a distinct physical regime from phased-array beamforming: NAH places a dense array at close standoff $z \ll \lambda$ with aperture at least as large as the vibrating source surface so exponentially decaying evanescent waves are captured for sub-wavelength spatial resolution—requiring wavenumber regularization to prevent severe sensor-noise amplification during back-propagation ([Maynard et al. 1985, §III](https://doi.org/10.1121/1.392911); Williams 1999)—whereas phased-array beamforming operates at standoff $z \gtrsim D$ on propagating waves alone, allowing compact arrays to image wide structures at the cost of the Rayleigh diffraction limit $\Delta x \sim \lambda z / D$.

locator_hits_first5.text: 在任意拓扑方向上，TI-GEVD-DANSE 引入共享规范化是为了抑制多节点求和支路的公共尺度漂移（参见 [Didier 等 2024，§III–IV](https://ftp.esat.kuleuven.be/sista/pdidier/eusipco2024/eusipco24_pdidier_submission_v1.pdf)）；TI-DANSE$^+$ 则进一步利用根节点汇聚多分支部分和提升收敛速度，并在扩展研究中详细分析了在线更新时如何按批次隔离不同广播版本的统计量（参见 [2025 会议论文 §III–IV](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.20001v1) 与 [2026 扩展稿 §III-C、§III-G](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.02797v2)）。从更宏大的视角来看，KU Leuven（鲁汶大学）Bertrand 团队近年提出的**分布式自适应信号融合（Distributed Adaptive Signal Fusion，DASF）**统一理论框架，已经把本章的 DANSE、分布式 MVDR / LCMV 波束形成、分布式 GEVD 乃至分布式典型相关分析（CCA），全部纳入同一个“受限通信图上的交替压缩子空间投影优化”数学母体之中，为设计新型分布式音频算法提供了通用的收敛判据。

前面我们主要围绕无约束均方误差 $J_u(\vec w)$ 讨论分布式压缩，而在语音增强与干扰抑制工程中，我们同样经常求解最小方差无失真响应（MVDR）、最大输出信噪比（主广义特征向量）以及带多个干扰零陷的线性约束最小方差（LCMV）波束形成。Musluoglu 与 Bertrand（Part I）及 Musluoglu、Hovine 与 Bertrand（Part II）建立的 **DASF** 框架（*IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing*，vol. 71，第 1863～1878 页与第 1879～1894 页，2023；2022 年预印）指出：只要优化目标与线性约束仅通过滤波输出 $\vec w^H\vec x$ 依赖二阶统计，节点 $u$ 在收到每个远端节点 $R$ 路压缩流（全连接局部维数 $L_u = M_u + (U - 1)R$，对应压缩矩阵 $\mathbf T_u \in \mathbb{C}^{M \times L_u}$）时，局部压缩问题与集中式原问题具有完全同构的投影形式：

一旦加入干扰零陷构成 $P$ 重线性约束 $\mathbf C^H\vec w = \vec f$（$\mathbf C \in \mathbb{C}^{M \times P}$ 列满秩），记约束 Gram 矩阵 $\mathbf M = \mathbf C^H\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C$ 与乘子 $\vec\mu = \mathbf M^{-1}\vec f$，集中式最优解 $\vec w_{\mathrm{LCMV}}^\star$ 变为 $\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C\vec\mu$，其远端分块不再落在单源方向 $\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\vec a$ 上；若远端死守旧的 MVDR 广播，局部节点虽仍能强行满足约束，输出残余噪声却显著高于集中式下界，必须通过 DASF 轮转更新压缩器才能重新对齐最优子空间。

从发展脉络看，早在通用 DASF 框架之前，Markovich-Golan、Gannot 与 Cohen（EUSIPCO 2012；*IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing*，vol. 21，no. 2，第 343～356 页，2013）便已将[第 5 章广义旁瓣相消器（GSC）](05_beamforming.md)推广至全连接 WASN，提出**分布式多约束 GSC / LCMV**：各节点先在本地分离出满足 $P$ 重线性约束的固定波束支路与阻塞矩阵噪声参考支路，再在节点间交换低维投影流并分布式自适应调整干扰对消权重，构成了连接第 5 章 GSC 架构与上述 DASF-LCMV 统一子空间理论的重要桥梁。

在无需显式空间先验的纯盲 DANSE 之外，若系统还需联合执行跨节点声源定位、空间扇区约束或 DASF-LCMV 零陷控制，就必须先解决**自组网节点几何自定位（Node Self-Localization）**：典型手段包括利用多声源事件到达时差（TDOA）建立成对距离约束后经多维标度（MDS）或非线性最小二乘联合反演节点坐标与声源位置，以及在漫反射环境噪声段利用三维各向同性扩散声场相干模型 $\operatorname{Re}\{\Gamma_{uv}(f)\} \approx \operatorname{sinc}(2f d_{uv} / c)$ 盲反演未知节点间距 $d_{uv}$。

On general trees, TI-GEVD-DANSE stabilizes shared-sum scaling ([Didier et al. 2024, §§III–IV](https://ftp.esat.kuleuven.be/sista/pdidier/eusipco2024/eusipco24_pdidier_submission_v1.pdf)), while TI-DANSE$^+$ accelerates convergence via multi-branch root fusion and analyzes batch-isolated covariance estimation across broadcast updates ([2025 conference paper §§III–IV](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.20001v1); [2026 extended preprint §§III-C, III-G](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.02797v2)). Unifying all of these, the KU Leuven Bertrand group's **Distributed Adaptive Signal Fusion (DASF)** framework casts DANSE, distributed MVDR/LCMV, distributed GEVD, and distributed Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) as alternating compressed-subspace optimization over communication graphs.

Extending beyond unconstrained MSE $J_u(\vec w)$ to MVDR, max-SNR GEVD, and multi-null LCMV beamformers, the **DASF** framework developed by Musluoglu and Bertrand (Part I) and Musluoglu, Hovine, and Bertrand (Part II) (*IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing*, vol. 71, pp. 1863–1878 and pp. 1879–1894, 2023; 2022 preprints) shows that whenever objectives and linear constraints depend on data solely through $\vec w^H\vec x$ second-order statistics, node $u$ receiving $R$ streams per peer ($L_u = M_u + (U - 1)R$, projection $\mathbf T_u \in \mathbb{C}^{M \times L_u}$) solves an isomorphic compressed problem:

Once interference nulls form $P$ linear constraints $\mathbf C^H\vec w = \vec f$ ($\mathbf C \in \mathbb{C}^{M \times P}$ full column rank), with $\mathbf M = \mathbf C^H\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C$ and $\vec\mu = \mathbf M^{-1}\vec f$, centralized $\vec w_{\mathrm{LCMV}}^\star = \mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C\vec\mu$ swings its remote block away from $\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\vec a$; keeping the old MVDR broadcast satisfies constraints locally at inflated output noise until DASF updates realign the compressor.

Historically, a decade before the general DASF formulation, Markovich-Golan, Gannot, and Cohen (EUSIPCO 2012; *IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing*, vol. 21, no. 2, pp. 343–356, 2013) directly generalized [Chapter 5's Generalized Sidelobe Canceller (GSC)](05_beamforming.md) to fully connected WASNs (**Distributed Multiple-Constraint GSC / LCMV**): each node splits its local observations into a constraint-preserving fixed beamformer branch and a local blocking-matrix noise-reference branch, exchanges reduced-dimension projections with peers, and adapts interference-cancelling weights distributively—forming a direct architectural bridge between Chapter 5's GSC and the unified DASF-LCMV subspace theory above.

Beyond purely blind DANSE requiring no explicit spatial priors, any system that jointly performs cross-node source localization, spatial sector constraints, or DASF-LCMV interference nulling must first solve **ad-hoc node geometry self-localization**: standard approaches use multi-source Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) measurements to establish pairwise distance constraints solved jointly for node and source coordinates via Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) or nonlinear least squares, or exploit ambient diffuse-noise segments with the 3D isotropic diffuse coherence model $\operatorname{Re}\{\Gamma_{uv}(f)\} \approx \operatorname{sinc}(2f d_{uv} / c)$ to invert unknown inter-node distances $d_{uv}$ blindly.

Imagine a long conference table holding two smart pickup devices, each equipped with two microphones: Device 1 sits right next to the main presenter, whereas Device 2 sits beside an HVAC diffuser or projector cooling fan. From a signal-processing standpoint, a remote device's audio offers two distinct forms of collaborative value—it might sit closer to the target talker than the local device, supplying a high-SNR speech observation; or it might sit right next to an interferer, supplying the clean noise reference the local device desperately needs to cancel correlated interference. Crudely "switching on only the loudest device" throws away the spatial noise-cancellation aperture of every other device; conversely, running ASR independently on each device and merging transcripts at the text level abandons waveform-level phase coherence across devices altogether.

[Chapter 10, §10.7](10_engineering-practice.md#sec-10-7) surveyed time-axis alignment, amplitude–phase consistency, and multi-stream fusion from a system-architecture perspective. Here we dive into the algorithmic core to answer four progressive questions step by step: without transmitting all raw microphone channels, under what exact condition can nodes still attain the optimal linear estimate of a centralized full array? How do nodes alternately update broadcast filters without knowing global statistics? How do multiple sources and non-fully-connected network topologies bound broadcast dimensionality? And when transitioning to finite windowed frames, 16-bit quantization, crystal Sampling Rate Offset (SRO), and wireless packet loss, how do we transform statistical coordinates and score errors honestly?

locator_hits_first5.text: 就本章涉及的语音分离模块而言，排序的核心原则有两条：一是**先借 MIMO-WPE 压低长混响拖尾**，帮窄带近似式(8-2)与目标空间协方差恢复清晰的秩一方向结构（各通道 WPE 独立滤波后宜由目标 SCM 提取自适应 RTF，而非硬套自由场几何导向矢量）；二是**控制支路与音频主路严格分流**——说话人日志向 GSS 提供二值活动门控，GSS 产出软掩码后再回到未归一化的多麦复谱上统计 SCM 并求解 MVDR/GEV，而端到端多通道神经分离或 CSS 则作为 WPE 之后的替代多流主路运行（评测“AEC 与降噪/分离谁先谁后”时，须警惕用干净真值生成理想双讲判决的真值泄漏陷阱，详见[上游接口研究手册](../codes/chapters/ch00/research/02_aec_wpe_separation.md)）。
在实际工程中，标准批处理版面向整段迭代（流式场景需改写为递推协方差与后文的 ISS 秩一更新），强混响导致的窄带失配、多人包络高度同步或统计帧数过短都会削弱分离表现——这些属于观测模型或样本量限制，不能笼统归咎为原声源失去物理独立性。它常作为免训练盲源分离基线。

仔细审视式(8-8)的计算开销：每轮迭代中，IP 需要为每个频点、每个声源分别在 $T$ 帧上累加 $M\times M$ 矩阵 $\mathbf V_{nf}$（$O(TM^2)$）并求解一次 $M\times M$ 线性方程组（$O(M^3)$），单频点扫完全部 $M$ 个源的完整一轮总开销高达 $O(TM^3+M^4)$，在大通道数阵列或低功耗流式场景下显得相当沉重。**迭代源导向（Iterative Source Steering，ISS；[Scheibler 与 Ono，ICASSP 2020](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICASSP40776.2020.9053556)）**提出了一种无需任何矩阵求逆的秩一更新机制：不再一次只重算 $\mathbf W_f$ 的某一行，而是在第 $k$ 步（$k=1,\dots,M$）沿当前第 $k$ 行 $\vec w_{kf}^H$ 的方向，用一个复数导向向量 $\vec v_k=[v_{1k},\dots,v_{Mk}]^\top\in\mathbb{C}^{M\times 1}$ 对 $\mathbf W_f$ 的**全部 $M$ 行同时作秩一修正**：

在线 AuxIVA-ISS 用带遗忘因子 $\alpha\in[0,1)$ 的递推式更新加权协方差，再用这些协方差计算 ISS 系数并更新解混矩阵。单次秩一修正本身的开销为 $O(M^2)$，系数计算还要逐路做矩阵与向量的乘法。[Nakashima 与 Ono，APSIPA ASC 2022](https://doi.org/10.23919/APSIPAASC55919.2022.9979837) 在模拟三说话人混合中测试了一路声源突然换位的情形。已知移动声源索引时，可以只沿该索引做导向更新。实际部署仍需防范遗忘因子过小引发的估计波动，以及全员静音时加权协方差退化。

**MNMF（多通道非负矩阵分解，Multichannel NMF）**。前面推导的 AuxIVA 与 ILRMA 都建立在“存在可逆方阵 $\mathbf W_f$ 将混合点声源一刀切开”的假设上，一旦遇到**欠定混合**（例如 $2$ 支麦克风录 $3$ 个人同时说话，$N>M$）或是强混响使单源空间协方差不再是秩一矩阵，方阵解混框架便力不从心。MNMF 彻底抛弃了确定性解混矩阵 $\mathbf W_f$，直接在观测域为每个声源 $n$ 的多麦源图像 $\vec c_{nft}\in\mathbb{C}^{M\times 1}$ 建立**满秩空间协方差生成模型**。

For the speech-separation modules covered in this chapter, two core ordering rules govern integration: first, **run MIMO-WPE first to suppress long reverberation tails**, helping the narrowband model Eq. (8-2) and target spatial covariance recover a clean rank-one directional structure (since per-channel WPE filtering can introduce slight inter-channel transfer offsets, downstream beamformers should extract adaptive RTFs from the target SCM rather than rigidly applying free-field geometric steering vectors); second, **keep control branches and the main audio trunk strictly separated**—speaker diarization supplies binary activity gates to GSS, GSS emits soft masks that return to the unnormalized multichannel complex spectra to accumulate SCMs and solve MVDR/GEV, while end-to-end multichannel neural separators or CSS run as an alternative multi-stream main trunk downstream of WPE (when benchmarking "AEC before NR/separation vs. after," watch out for ground-truth leakage traps that build ideal double-talk decisions from clean oracle signals; see the [Upstream Interface Research Notes](../codes/chapters/ch00/research_en/02_aec_wpe_separation.md)).

Inspect the compute budget of Eq. (8-8): in every iteration, IP accumulates an $M\times M$ matrix $\mathbf V_{nf}$ over $T$ frames ($O(TM^2)$) and solves an $M\times M$ linear system ($O(M^3)$) for every source, costing $O(TM^3+M^4)$ per frequency bin for a full $M$-source sweep—a heavy burden for larger microphone arrays or low-power streaming hardware. **Iterative Source Steering (ISS; [Scheibler & Ono, ICASSP 2020](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICASSP40776.2020.9053556))** introduces a matrix-inversion-free rank-one update: instead of recomputing one row of $\mathbf W_f$ at a time, at step $k$ ($k=1,\dots,M$) it applies a **rank-one correction to all $M$ rows of $\mathbf W_f$ simultaneously** along the current $k$-th row $\vec w_{kf}^H$ via a complex steering vector $\vec v_k=[v_{1k},\dots,v_{Mk}]^\top\in\mathbb{C}^{M\times 1}$:

Online AuxIVA-ISS updates its weighted covariances recursively with forgetting factor $\alpha\in[0,1)$ and uses those covariances to compute the ISS coefficients and update the demixing matrix. A rank-one correction itself takes $O(M^2)$ operations, with covariance–vector products still needed to form its coefficients. [Nakashima & Ono, APSIPA ASC 2022](https://doi.org/10.23919/APSIPAASC55919.2022.9979837) tested a simulated mixture of three speakers with one source changing position abruptly. When the moving source index is known, the steering update can use that index alone. In practice, a very small forgetting factor can make the estimates fluctuate, and weighted covariances can become degenerate during all-speaker silences.
Because any zero entry in a multiplicative update remains permanently trapped at $0$, practical implementations initialize strictly with positive random numbers and apply a positive power floor.

**MNMF (Multichannel Nonnegative Matrix Factorization)**. Both AuxIVA and ILRMA rest on the premise that an invertible square matrix $\mathbf W_f$ can cleanly slice apart point sources; when confronted with **underdetermined mixtures** (e.g., $2$ microphones recording $3$ simultaneous speakers, $N>M$) or heavy reverberation where a single speaker's spatial covariance is no longer rank-one, square unmixing breaks down. MNMF dispenses with deterministic unmixing matrices $\mathbf W_f$ altogether and instead builds a **full-rank spatial covariance generative model** directly in the observation space for each source's multi-microphone image $\vec c_{nft}\in\mathbb{C}^{M\times 1}$.

locator_hits_first5.text: 关联器采用门限 $15^\circ$ 内的两轨**全局最近邻（Global Nearest Neighbour，GNN）**一对一分配：优先最大化门内成功配对条数，在此前提下最小化圆周角残差平方和；遇到总代价严格相等的并列情形，则按轨迹与输入观测列表的先后次序打破平局。在一般 $M$ 条轨迹与 $N$ 个观测的工程实现中，GNN 将门内马氏距离或负对数似然比填入 $M\times N$ 代价块（门外填 $+\infty$），并在右侧增广 $M\times M$ 的漏检虚拟对角块（对角元填门控阈值 $\gamma_G$，非对角元填 $+\infty$），构成允许主动漏检的最小代价指派问题。它与前述“先最大配对数”的目标并不普遍等价：例如门内代价矩阵为 $[0,8;\ 8,+\infty]$、每条漏检代价为 $9$ 时，两条配对总代价为 $16$，而只取零代价配对加一次漏检为 $9$，后者会被最小代价方案选中。应先按检测模型确定目标；若要求配对数优先，可分两步先求最大基数，再在其中最小化距离。上述线性指派可通过匈牙利（Kuhn–Munkres / Jonker–Volgenant）算法在 $O(\max(M,N)^3)$ 多项式时间内求全局最小总代价匹配（对偶原理与指派算例详见[第 0 章 §0.6.4](00_math-foundations.md#sec-0-6-4)）。相比之下，逐轨按编号顺序就近抢占的贪心最近邻（`NearestNeighbour`，NN）一旦让前序轨迹夺走了本属于邻近轨迹的唯一观测，后序轨迹便被迫漏检或远距错配（Stone Soup 框架的 [`neighbour.py`](https://github.com/dstl/Stone-Soup/blob/8d1edeb07ef8505ed065cbef435cfb5e517d9bdc/stonesoup/dataassociator/neighbour.py) 即严格区分了逐轨贪心的 `NearestNeighbour` 与全局最优指派的 `GlobalNearestNeighbour`）。

Data association uses gated two-track **Global Nearest Neighbour (GNN)** one-to-one assignment within a $15^\circ$ gate: maximizing the number of gated matches first, then minimizing sum of squared circular residuals, breaking exact ties by track and measurement list order. In general $M$-track, $N$-measurement implementations, GNN populates an $M\times N$ block with gated Mahalanobis distances or negative log-likelihood ratios ($+\infty$ outside gates), appends an $M\times M$ diagonal missed-detection block on the right (gate threshold $\gamma_G$ on the diagonal, $+\infty$ off-diagonal), and minimizes total assignment cost while allowing misses. This objective is not generally equivalent to maximizing match cardinality first: with gated costs $[0,8;\ 8,+\infty]$ and a miss cost of $9$ per track, two matches cost $16$, whereas one zero-cost match plus one miss costs $9$, so total-cost minimization chooses the latter. Select the objective from the detection model; cardinality-first matching can be implemented in two stages, first maximizing cardinality and then minimizing distance among those matchings. The linear assignment can be solved via the Hungarian (Kuhn–Munkres / Jonker–Volgenant) algorithm in $O(\max(M,N)^3)$ time (for duality proofs and worked assignment examples, see [Chapter 0, §0.6.4](00_math-foundations.md#sec-0-6-4)). By contrast, sequential greedy `NearestNeighbour` (NN) lets earlier-indexed tracks claim shared measurements away from neighboring tracks, forcing later tracks into misses or distant misassociations (Stone Soup's [`neighbour.py`](https://github.com/dstl/Stone-Soup/blob/8d1edeb07ef8505ed065cbef435cfb5e517d9bdc/stonesoup/dataassociator/neighbour.py) explicitly separates greedy `NearestNeighbour` from optimal `GlobalNearestNeighbour`).

最小方差无失真响应（MVDR）、广义特征值（GEV）波束形成以及后文的 MNMF，都围绕多通道观测的**空间协方差矩阵（SCM）**展开。在统计窗口内混合矩阵 $\mathbf A$ 恒定、且声源与加性噪声互不相关（$\mathbb{E}[\vec S\vec V^H]=\mathbf 0$）的前提下，省略频点与帧号下标可得：
| 经典盲源分离（BSS） | ICA、AuxIVA、ILRMA、MNMF | 利用各声源间的统计独立性与跨频包络/低秩谱结构，迭代求解解混矩阵或空间模型 | 方阵 AuxIVA/ILRMA 面向 $N=M$ 确定混合；免预训练，但依赖足够统计帧数与窄带近似 |
### 8.3 经典盲源分离：AuxIVA、ILRMA、MNMF 与 TRINICON
“盲源分离”中的“盲”是指不向估计器提供干净源真值或已知混合矩阵，但这绝不意味着随便给一段混合录音就能唯一还原真实声源——算法必须在明确的统计可辨识前提下才能锁定解混方向。下面先厘清独立成分分析的可辨识边界，再依次推演源包络耦合、低秩谱建模与空间协方差对角化四代经典算法。

- **Underdetermined mixture ($N>M$)**: speakers outnumber microphones (the extreme case being a single microphone $M=1$, where inter-channel spatial phase cues are completely absent). Here no linear square matrix inverse can perfectly unmix all sources, so separation must rely on full-rank spatial covariances paired with low-rank spectral structure in multichannel NMF (MNMF), sparse time-frequency masks, or speech priors learned by deep neural networks.

Minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamforming, generalized eigenvalue (GEV) beamforming, and MNMF all revolve around the **spatial covariance matrix (SCM)** of multichannel observations. Assuming the mixing matrix $\mathbf A$ is constant over the statistical estimation window and sources are uncorrelated with additive noise ($\mathbb{E}[\vec S\vec V^H]=\mathbf 0$), omitting frequency and frame subscripts yields:

| Classical Blind Source Separation (BSS) | ICA, AuxIVA, ILRMA, MNMF | Exploits statistical independence across sources together with cross-frequency envelope coupling or low-rank spectral structure to iteratively solve unmixing matrices or spatial models | Square AuxIVA/ILRMA targets determined mixtures ($N=M$); training-free, but requires sufficient frames for statistics and valid narrowband approximation |
### 8.3 Classical Blind Source Separation: AuxIVA, ILRMA, MNMF, and TRINICON

The word "blind" in blind source separation means that neither clean source ground truth nor the mixing matrix is provided to the estimator—yet it certainly does not mean that feeding an arbitrary mixture guarantees unique recovery of the true sources; an algorithm can lock onto unmixing directions only under well-defined statistical identifiability conditions. Below we first establish the identifiability boundaries of independent component analysis (ICA), then systematically derive four generations of classical algorithms spanning source envelope coupling, low-rank spectral modeling, and spatial covariance diagonalization.

locator_hits_first5.text: **未知说话人数场景下的递归分离：OR-PIT 与 RSAN**：上述深度分离网络多按固定输出头数 $N$ 配合整句 `uPIT` 训练，而流式 `CSS` 通常在短块内固定 $2$ 个输出槽位并辅以单人旁路门控。当整段混合录音中的说话人数 $N$ 预先未知且可能大于固定槽位数时，文献形成了两类经典的**递归逐人剥离**架构：
- **循环选择性注意力网络（Recurrent Selective Attention Network，RSAN；Kinoshita 等，ICASSP 2018）**：在 STFT 时频域显式维护一张逐点非负的**残余掩码预算** $R^{(k)}$，初始置 $R^{(0)}=\mathbf 1$，第 $k$ 步结合混合谱与剩余预算输出一位说话人的时频掩码 $M^{(k)}$，并按

递推更新下一轮可用掩码（$k=1,2,\ldots$：先用 $R^{(k-1)}$ 估计本轮 $M^{(k)}$，再扣除它）。这里的索引与[同作者 2019 年块在线扩展 §2.1～2.2、式(1)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1902.07881)一致；剩余掩码平均值 $\frac1{TF}\sum_{t,f}R^{(k)}_{tf}$ 低于门限 $\tau$ 时停止。与 OR-PIT 不同，RSAN 在掩码域显式维护残余注意力预算，无需把分离出的时域残余波形反复送回前端编码器重新提特征。

在真实多人会议部署中，整句级递归的 OR-PIT 与 RSAN 仍受限于串行延迟随人数线性递增、强噪声/混响下停止门限 $\tau$ 易误触发以及长流跨块身份对齐等瓶颈；因此工业会议前端通常优先采用**双槽流式 CSS**（利用 $1.2\text{～}2.4\ \mathrm{s}$ 短块内三人以上同时抢话概率较低的统计规律并配单人旁路保护），或在[第 15 章](15_target-extraction-diarization.md)进一步引入由日志模型显式给出人数与活动区间的**日志导引分离前端**（如 `TS-VAD` + `WPE` + `GSS`）。

**Recursive Separation for Unknown Speaker Counts: OR-PIT vs. RSAN**: The deep separators above are predominantly trained with fixed-$N$ `uPIT` output heads, while streaming `CSS` fixes $2$ slots per short chunk guarded by single-speaker bypass. When the active speaker count $N$ in an utterance is unknown in advance and may exceed any fixed head count, two canonical **recursive one-by-one separation** architectures emerge:

- **Recurrent Selective Attention Network (RSAN; Kinoshita et al., ICASSP 2018)**: operates in the STFT time–frequency domain by maintaining an explicit nonnegative **residual mask budget** $R^{(k)}$ initialized at $R^{(0)}=\mathbf 1$, emitting one speaker mask $M^{(k)}$ per iteration and updating the remaining budget via

for $k=1,2,\ldots$: first estimate current mask $M^{(k)}$ from $R^{(k-1)}$, then subtract it. This indexing follows the [same authors' 2019 block-online extension, §§2.1–2.2, Eq. (1)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1902.07881); stop when mean remaining mask $\frac1{TF}\sum_{t,f}R^{(k)}_{tf}$ falls below $\tau$. Unlike OR-PIT, RSAN explicitly maintains a residual attention budget inside the mask domain without feeding separated time-domain residuals back through a front-end encoder.

In real multi-party meetings, utterance-level recursive OR-PIT and RSAN still face sequential latency growth, stopping-threshold fragility under noise and reverberation, and cross-chunk permutation stitching across long streams; production conference pipelines therefore typically prefer either **two-slot streaming CSS** (exploiting the low odds of $\ge 3$ simultaneous speakers inside $1.2$–$2.4\ \mathrm{s}$ chunks alongside single-speaker bypass) or the **diarization-guided front ends** developed in [Chapter 15](15_target-extraction-diarization.md) (such as `TS-VAD` + `WPE` + `GSS`, where explicit diarization supplies both speaker count and temporal activity).

关键转折发生在第 $2\ \mathrm{s}$：按匀速外推，轨迹 A 与轨迹 B 的先验预测角双双到达 $40^\circ$，而本帧真值恰为相对 $40^\circ$ 精确对称的 $A=41^\circ,B=39^\circ$（到达观测按列表顺序依次为原本属于 B 的 $39^\circ$ 与原本属于 A 的 $41^\circ$）。此时“A 配 $39^\circ$、B 配 $41^\circ$”与“A 配 $41^\circ$、B 配 $39^\circ$”的残差平方和完全并列，同为 $(-1)^2+1^2=2\ \mathrm{deg}^2$；平局规则遂将第一条观测 $39^\circ$ 派给 A、第二条观测 $41^\circ$ 派给 B，当场产生 $2$ 次身份错配。然而如果抹去身份标签只看集合，当帧观测集与真值集同为 $\{39^\circ,41^\circ\}$，按后文式(9-41)算出的未滤波观测集 OSPA 距离却是 $0^\circ$（注意滤波后状态因融合了先验 $40^\circ$ 与各自相反的速度惯性，仍带有非零估计误差）。
#### OSPA：集合位置与人数的归一化误差

多目标追踪每帧输出估计集合 $Y=\{y_1,\ldots,y_n\}$，而真值集合为 $X=\{x_1,\ldots,x_m\}$，当 $m\neq n$ 时普通单目标 RMSE 根本无法计算。多目标跟踪领域普遍采用**最优子模式分配距离（Optimal Subpattern Assignment，OSPA）**将“位置偏了多少”与“人数估错几个”统一折算进同一个具有物理角度/距离量纲的严格度量中（见 Schuhmacher、Vo 与 Vo 2008 原始论文，IEEE TSP 56(8), pp. 3447–3457，[DOI 10.1109/TSP.2008.920469](https://doi.org/10.1109/TSP.2008.920469)）。
#### GOSPA：把定位、漏检与虚警分开

Because these algorithms handle association, cardinality, and labels differently, evaluation metrics must separate them too: Optimal Subpattern Assignment (OSPA) jointly scores localization and cardinality errors while ignoring track identity continuity, which our crossing experiment below evaluates explicitly.

The pivotal moment arrives at $t=2\ \mathrm{s}$: constant-velocity prediction brings *both* Track A and Track B to $40^\circ$, while ground-truth azimuths are strictly symmetric around $40^\circ$ at $A=41^\circ, B=39^\circ$ (arriving in list order $[39^\circ\text{ (from B)},\ 41^\circ\text{ (from A)}]$). Pairing (A$\to 39^\circ$, B$\to 41^\circ$) and (A$\to 41^\circ$, B$\to 39^\circ$) tie identically at $(-1)^2+1^2=2\ \mathrm{deg}^2$; tie-breaking assigns first-listed $39^\circ$ to A and $41^\circ$ to B, incurring $2$ identity mismatches on the spot. Yet stripping labels leaves identical raw measurement and ground-truth sets $\{39^\circ,41^\circ\}$, scoring a $0^\circ$ raw-set OSPA via Eq. (9-41) (filtered states still carry nonzero error from blending prior $40^\circ$ and opposite velocity inertias).
#### OSPA: Normalized Set Distance Across Localization and Cardinality

At each frame, multi-target trackers emit an estimated set $Y=\{y_1,\ldots,y_n\}$ against ground-truth set $X=\{x_1,\ldots,x_m\}$; whenever $m\neq n$, ordinary single-target RMSE is undefined. Multi-target tracking universally adopts the **Optimal Subpattern Assignment (OSPA)** metric to combine "how far off are positions?" and "by how many targets is the count wrong?" into a rigorous metric carrying physical angle/length units (Schuhmacher, Vo & Vo 2008, *IEEE TSP* 56(8), pp. 3447–3457, [DOI 10.1109/TSP.2008.920469](https://doi.org/10.1109/TSP.2008.920469)).

locator_hits_first5.text: - **空间白噪声**：麦克风电子热噪声、前置放大器底噪与局部非相关扰动，$\mathbf R_{nn}=\phi_n\mathbf I$（抗此类底噪及阵元失配的能力用白噪声增益 WNG 度量）；室外风噪源于麦克风防风罩附近的局部气压湍流，相关尺度远小于声波长，也更接近空间白噪声（Corcos 湍流风噪模型见[第 14 章 §14.8](14_spatial-wearable-arrays.md#sec-14-8)）。
当满足无失真约束 $\vec w^H\vec a=1$ 时，$G_{\mathrm{WNG}}=1/\|\vec w\|_2^2$ 直接由权重二范数决定：权重模长越大，阵元底噪和通道幅相失配就被放大得越厉害。

6. **通道增益失配放大**：若麦 2 存在 $1\%$ 幅度正偏差（$\vec a_{\mathrm{mis}}=[1,1.01e^{+\mathrm{j}0.3142}]^\top$），超指向输出响应变为 $1.0050-0.0236\mathrm{j}$，偏离 $1$ 达 $2.41\%$（是 DSB 偏差 $0.5\%$ 的近 $5$ 倍，严格上界见 [E05-03](#e05-03)）。
上线前应对求出的权重做四项部署前核查：① 白噪声增益余量 $\mathrm{WNG}_{\mathrm{dB}}$；② 待求逆矩阵二范数条件数 $\kappa_2=\lambda_{\max}/\lambda_{\min}$；③ 高声压下的峰值动态范围与削波率；④ 按器件与结构公差注入随机幅相失配扫描响应偏差与零陷漂移。

3. **MEMS 密封垫圈漏气相位失配**：$d=1$～$2\ \mathrm{cm}$ 在 $200\ \mathrm{Hz}$ 时的真实声程相位差 $\kappa d$ 仅 $2^\circ$～$4^\circ$，垫圈微漏气造成的一阶高通相移（$3^\circ$～$15^\circ$）比真实声程差还大，足以显著破坏后向零陷（[E05-16](#e05-16) 量化了 $5^\circ$ 漏气使后向响应超过名义前向单位响应 $+1.52\ \mathrm{dB}$ 的失效现象）。

- **Spatially white noise**: microphone electronic thermal noise, preamp noise floor, and local uncorrelated perturbations, $\mathbf R_{nn}=\phi_n\mathbf I$ (resilience against such noise and sensor mismatch is quantified by White Noise Gain, WNG); outdoor wind noise arises from local pressure turbulence near the windscreen with correlation scales far shorter than acoustic wavelengths and likewise behaves closer to spatially white noise (see Corcos turbulent wind modeling in [Chapter 14 §14.8](14_spatial-wearable-arrays.md#sec-14-8)).

Under the distortionless constraint $\vec w^H\vec a=1$, $G_{\mathrm{WNG}}=1/\|\vec w\|_2^2$ is governed directly by weight norm: the larger the weights grow, the more severely sensor self-noise and channel amplitude/phase mismatches are amplified.

6. **Gain-mismatch amplification**: a $+1\%$ amplitude error on Mic 2 ($\vec a_{\mathrm{mis}}=[1,1.01e^{+\mathrm{j}0.3142}]^\top$) shifts the superdirective output to $1.0050-0.0236\mathrm{j}$—a $2.41\%$ error, nearly $5\times$ DSB's $0.5\%$ deviation (tight bound in [E05-03](#e05-03)).

Before deployment, run four mandatory checks on computed weights: (i) $\mathrm{WNG}_{\mathrm{dB}}$ margin; (ii) $2$-norm condition number $\kappa_2=\lambda_{\max}/\lambda_{\min}$ of the inverted matrix; (iii) high-SPL peak headroom and clipping rate; (iv) Monte Carlo random amplitude/phase mismatch sweeps based on component tolerances to bound gain ripple and null drift.

3. **MEMS acoustic gasket-leakage phase mismatch**: at $d=1$–$2\ \mathrm{cm}$ and $200\ \mathrm{Hz}$, true acoustic phase difference $\kappa d$ is only $2^\circ$–$4^\circ$, so a tiny gasket leak introducing a first-order high-pass phase shift of $3^\circ$–$15^\circ$ overwhelms the acoustic path difference and severely degrades the rear null ([E05-16](#e05-16) quantifies how a $5^\circ$ leak lifts rear response $+1.52\ \mathrm{dB}$ above the nominal unit front response).

- **数据相关自适应波束**：最小方差无失真响应（Minimum Variance Distortionless Response，MVDR）在保持目标方向复响应无失真的线性约束下最小化总输出功率；线性约束最小方差（Linearly Constrained Minimum Variance，LCMV）进一步支持同时锁定多个目标或零陷方向响应。两者的实际收益都高度敏感于噪声协方差估计质量与目标导向矢量失配。
| 固定方向增强 | 延迟求和（DS）或固定超指向（superdirective）波束 | 干扰方向随时间变化且噪声协方差可稳健在线估计时，评估 MVDR 或 LCMV 波束形成 | 低频白噪声增益恶化、目标角度失配、阵元幅相失配 |
- **非共线三麦与平面阵**：在平面内提供两个线性无关的坐标基向量，足以唯一确定水平方位角，但对阵面法线上下两侧 $(+z \leftrightarrow -z)$ 的自由场平面波完全对称。工程落地时通常贴合桌面或吸顶安装，利用物理刚性边界面消除下半空间镜像。

最后回到阵列信号处理本身，把物理层指标与整机验收串成闭环。横向对比一组波束形成候选时，必须先把测试环境的真实噪声空间协方差矩阵、参考阵元目标定义以及允许的安装/定位角度偏差固定下来，同时核查输出残余噪声功率、存在方向偏差时的目标复响应失真以及白噪声增益 WNG。未加对角加载的标准 MVDR 往往能在纸面上把特定方向的干扰压到最低，但在高 SNR、非共线导向失配下可能伴随较大复权重范数与目标自相消；E11-20 的 $5^\circ$ 结果属于给定协方差与几何控制，不是普遍失效门限。

代入式(11-13) 得 $I = 10 - 22 - 23 + 20 = -15$ 个百分点：关闭 B 时开启 A 令 WER 升高 $2$ 个百分点，而开启 B 后再开启 A 却令 WER 骤降 $13$ 个百分点（例如模块 B 先抑制了强混响或对齐了时延，使原本因失配而发生目标自相消的自适应模块 A 恢复正常工作）。因此对物理机理上存在上下游依赖的模块对，选型消融实验必须覆盖完整的 $2\times 2$ 组合网格。

Before choosing any algorithm, write down quantitative answers to the following six questions item by item; each clearly answered question eliminates an entire class of mismatched array form factors and processing modules:

- **Data-dependent adaptive beamforming**: Minimum Variance Distortionless Response (MVDR) minimizes total output power subject to a linear distortionless complex response constraint in the target direction; Linearly Constrained Minimum Variance (LCMV) generalizes this to simultaneously lock responses across multiple target or null directions. Practical gains of both are highly sensitive to noise covariance estimation accuracy and target steering-vector mismatch.

| Fixed-direction enhancement | Delay-and-sum (DS) or fixed superdirective beamformer | Evaluate MVDR or LCMV beamforming when interferer directions vary over time and noise covariance can be estimated robustly online | Low-frequency white noise gain degradation, target angle mismatch, inter-sensor amplitude–phase mismatch |

| Identity continuity | Supplied by external tracking / diarization module | Separation slots do not represent permanent identities; diarization or voiceprint association is typically needed downstream | Target conditioning provides identity cues, subject to enrollment channel mismatch and spoofing |

- **Non-collinear three-microphone and planar arrays**: Span two linearly independent basis vectors in the plane—sufficient to uniquely resolve horizontal azimuth—yet remain completely symmetric with respect to free-field plane waves arriving from above versus below the array plane $(+z \leftrightarrow -z)$. Practical deployments typically mount planar arrays flush on a tabletop or ceiling, exploiting a rigid physical boundary to eliminate the lower-hemisphere mirror image.

locator_hits_first5.text: 本章前半部分围绕统一约束优化展开：在期望方向 $\theta_0$ 保持单位无失真响应（$\vec{w}^H\vec{a}(\theta_0)=1$）的前提下最小化噪声或干扰输出功率——延迟求和（DSB）、超指向（Superdirective）、最小方差无失真响应（MVDR）与线性约束最小方差（LCMV）本质上只是假定的噪声空间相关模型或约束个数不同；多通道维纳滤波（MWF）改为最小化波形均方误差，广义特征值（GEV）波束形成则最大化输出信噪比，将在后续小节展开。本章高频缩写如下：
| DOA 偏差导致目标明显衰减 | A 导向失配 | 最差情况 SOCP / RCB（按误差分布定 $\epsilon$） | 导数约束 LCMV（§5.5）展宽平顶 |
### 5.5 线性约束最小方差（LCMV）：多约束、导数平坦与双耳保真

把 $K_c$ 条线性约束按列拼成满列秩矩阵 $\mathbf C=[\vec c_1,\ldots,\vec c_{K_c}]\in\mathbb C^{M\times K_c}$、共轭期望响应排成 $\vec f\in\mathbb C^{K_c\times 1}$，在 $\mathbf C^H\vec w=\vec f$ 下最小化 $\vec w^H\mathbf R_{nn}\vec w$，由向量拉格朗日乘子对 $\vec w^*$ 求导（$\mathbf R_{nn}\vec w=\mathbf C\vec\lambda\implies\vec\lambda=(\mathbf C^H\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C)^{-1}\vec f$）得 LCMV 闭式解：
\vec w_{\mathrm{LCMV}}&=\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C\mathbf G^{-1}\vec f\text{。}

The first half of this chapter revolves around a unified constrained optimization principle: minimize noise or interference output power while preserving unit distortionless response ($\vec{w}^H\vec{a}(\theta_0)=1$) in desired direction $\theta_0$—Delay-and-Sum (DSB), Superdirective, Minimum Variance Distortionless Response (MVDR), and Linearly Constrained Minimum Variance (LCMV) differ solely in their assumed noise spatial correlation model or number of constraints. Multichannel Wiener Filtering (MWF) instead minimizes waveform mean-square error, and Generalized Eigenvalue (GEV) beamforming maximizes output SNR, as developed in later sections. Frequent acronyms in this chapter are summarized below:
| DOA jitter noticeably attenuates target | A. Steering mismatch | Worst-case SOCP / RCB (set $\epsilon$ from error spread) | Derivative-constrained LCMV (§5.5) flat mainlobe |
### 5.5 Linearly Constrained Minimum Variance (LCMV): Multi-Constraint, Derivative Flatness, and Binaural Fidelity

Stacking $K_c$ linearly independent constraints columnwise into full-column-rank $\mathbf C=[\vec c_1,\ldots,\vec c_{K_c}]\in\mathbb C^{M\times K_c}$ and conjugated desired responses into $\vec f\in\mathbb C^{K_c\times 1}$, minimizing $\vec w^H\mathbf R_{nn}\vec w$ subject to $\mathbf C^H\vec w=\vec f$ via vector Lagrange multipliers ($\mathbf R_{nn}\vec w=\mathbf C\vec\lambda\implies\vec\lambda=(\mathbf C^H\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C)^{-1}\vec f$) yields closed-form LCMV:
\vec w_{\mathrm{LCMV}}&=\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C\mathbf G^{-1}\vec f.

在任意拓扑方向上，TI-GEVD-DANSE 引入共享规范化是为了抑制多节点求和支路的公共尺度漂移（参见 [Didier 等 2024，§III–IV](https://ftp.esat.kuleuven.be/sista/pdidier/eusipco2024/eusipco24_pdidier_submission_v1.pdf)）；TI-DANSE$^+$ 则进一步利用根节点汇聚多分支部分和提升收敛速度，并在扩展研究中详细分析了在线更新时如何按批次隔离不同广播版本的统计量（参见 [2025 会议论文 §III–IV](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.20001v1) 与 [2026 扩展稿 §III-C、§III-G](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.02797v2)）。从更宏大的视角来看，KU Leuven（鲁汶大学）Bertrand 团队近年提出的**分布式自适应信号融合（Distributed Adaptive Signal Fusion，DASF）**统一理论框架，已经把本章的 DANSE、分布式 MVDR / LCMV 波束形成、分布式 GEVD 乃至分布式典型相关分析（CCA），全部纳入同一个“受限通信图上的交替压缩子空间投影优化”数学母体之中，为设计新型分布式音频算法提供了通用的收敛判据。

前面我们主要围绕无约束均方误差 $J_u(\vec w)$ 讨论分布式压缩，而在语音增强与干扰抑制工程中，我们同样经常求解最小方差无失真响应（MVDR）、最大输出信噪比（主广义特征向量）以及带多个干扰零陷的线性约束最小方差（LCMV）波束形成。Musluoglu 与 Bertrand（Part I）及 Musluoglu、Hovine 与 Bertrand（Part II）建立的 **DASF** 框架（*IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing*，vol. 71，第 1863～1878 页与第 1879～1894 页，2023；2022 年预印）指出：只要优化目标与线性约束仅通过滤波输出 $\vec w^H\vec x$ 依赖二阶统计，节点 $u$ 在收到每个远端节点 $R$ 路压缩流（全连接局部维数 $L_u = M_u + (U - 1)R$，对应压缩矩阵 $\mathbf T_u \in \mathbb{C}^{M \times L_u}$）时，局部压缩问题与集中式原问题具有完全同构的投影形式：

一旦加入干扰零陷构成 $P$ 重线性约束 $\mathbf C^H\vec w = \vec f$（$\mathbf C \in \mathbb{C}^{M \times P}$ 列满秩），记约束 Gram 矩阵 $\mathbf M = \mathbf C^H\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C$ 与乘子 $\vec\mu = \mathbf M^{-1}\vec f$，集中式最优解 $\vec w_{\mathrm{LCMV}}^\star$ 变为 $\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C\vec\mu$，其远端分块不再落在单源方向 $\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\vec a$ 上；若远端死守旧的 MVDR 广播，局部节点虽仍能强行满足约束，输出残余噪声却显著高于集中式下界，必须通过 DASF 轮转更新压缩器才能重新对齐最优子空间。

从发展脉络看，早在通用 DASF 框架之前，Markovich-Golan、Gannot 与 Cohen（EUSIPCO 2012；*IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing*，vol. 21，no. 2，第 343～356 页，2013）便已将[第 5 章广义旁瓣相消器（GSC）](05_beamforming.md)推广至全连接 WASN，提出**分布式多约束 GSC / LCMV**：各节点先在本地分离出满足 $P$ 重线性约束的固定波束支路与阻塞矩阵噪声参考支路，再在节点间交换低维投影流并分布式自适应调整干扰对消权重，构成了连接第 5 章 GSC 架构与上述 DASF-LCMV 统一子空间理论的重要桥梁。

在无需显式空间先验的纯盲 DANSE 之外，若系统还需联合执行跨节点声源定位、空间扇区约束或 DASF-LCMV 零陷控制，就必须先解决**自组网节点几何自定位（Node Self-Localization）**：典型手段包括利用多声源事件到达时差（TDOA）建立成对距离约束后经多维标度（MDS）或非线性最小二乘联合反演节点坐标与声源位置，以及在漫反射环境噪声段利用三维各向同性扩散声场相干模型 $\operatorname{Re}\{\Gamma_{uv}(f)\} \approx \operatorname{sinc}(2f d_{uv} / c)$ 盲反演未知节点间距 $d_{uv}$。

On general trees, TI-GEVD-DANSE stabilizes shared-sum scaling ([Didier et al. 2024, §§III–IV](https://ftp.esat.kuleuven.be/sista/pdidier/eusipco2024/eusipco24_pdidier_submission_v1.pdf)), while TI-DANSE$^+$ accelerates convergence via multi-branch root fusion and analyzes batch-isolated covariance estimation across broadcast updates ([2025 conference paper §§III–IV](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.20001v1); [2026 extended preprint §§III-C, III-G](https://arxiv.org/html/2506.02797v2)). Unifying all of these, the KU Leuven Bertrand group's **Distributed Adaptive Signal Fusion (DASF)** framework casts DANSE, distributed MVDR/LCMV, distributed GEVD, and distributed Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) as alternating compressed-subspace optimization over communication graphs.

Extending beyond unconstrained MSE $J_u(\vec w)$ to MVDR, max-SNR GEVD, and multi-null LCMV beamformers, the **DASF** framework developed by Musluoglu and Bertrand (Part I) and Musluoglu, Hovine, and Bertrand (Part II) (*IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing*, vol. 71, pp. 1863–1878 and pp. 1879–1894, 2023; 2022 preprints) shows that whenever objectives and linear constraints depend on data solely through $\vec w^H\vec x$ second-order statistics, node $u$ receiving $R$ streams per peer ($L_u = M_u + (U - 1)R$, projection $\mathbf T_u \in \mathbb{C}^{M \times L_u}$) solves an isomorphic compressed problem:

Once interference nulls form $P$ linear constraints $\mathbf C^H\vec w = \vec f$ ($\mathbf C \in \mathbb{C}^{M \times P}$ full column rank), with $\mathbf M = \mathbf C^H\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C$ and $\vec\mu = \mathbf M^{-1}\vec f$, centralized $\vec w_{\mathrm{LCMV}}^\star = \mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\mathbf C\vec\mu$ swings its remote block away from $\mathbf R_{nn}^{-1}\vec a$; keeping the old MVDR broadcast satisfies constraints locally at inflated output noise until DASF updates realign the compressor.

Historically, a decade before the general DASF formulation, Markovich-Golan, Gannot, and Cohen (EUSIPCO 2012; *IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing*, vol. 21, no. 2, pp. 343–356, 2013) directly generalized [Chapter 5's Generalized Sidelobe Canceller (GSC)](05_beamforming.md) to fully connected WASNs (**Distributed Multiple-Constraint GSC / LCMV**): each node splits its local observations into a constraint-preserving fixed beamformer branch and a local blocking-matrix noise-reference branch, exchanges reduced-dimension projections with peers, and adapts interference-cancelling weights distributively—forming a direct architectural bridge between Chapter 5's GSC and the unified DASF-LCMV subspace theory above.

Beyond purely blind DANSE requiring no explicit spatial priors, any system that jointly performs cross-node source localization, spatial sector constraints, or DASF-LCMV interference nulling must first solve **ad-hoc node geometry self-localization**: standard approaches use multi-source Time Difference of Arrival (TDOA) measurements to establish pairwise distance constraints solved jointly for node and source coordinates via Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) or nonlinear least squares, or exploit ambient diffuse-noise segments with the 3D isotropic diffuse coherence model $\operatorname{Re}\{\Gamma_{uv}(f)\} \approx \operatorname{sinc}(2f d_{uv} / c)$ to invert unknown inter-node distances $d_{uv}$ blindly.

硬件拾音链决定了后续一切阵列信号处理的物理上限。微机电系统（MEMS）麦克风选型至少需要联合核查五项电声指标：等效输入噪声（Equivalent Input Noise，EIN，或 $94\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ 下的信噪比）、声学过载点（Acoustic Overload Point，AOP）、灵敏度公差、频响平坦度（含低频滚降角频率与高频亥姆霍兹腔谐振峰）以及批次间幅相一致性。器件手册上的裸麦典型值绝不能代替整机声学实测——壳体导音孔直径与长度、防尘防水网阻尼、泡棉密封漏气以及电源纹波耦合都会显著改变阵元到达幅度与相位。

| Smart speaker | 2–6 mic circular/linear array (PDM/I²S/TDM) | Speaker cavity vibration isolation, silicone sealing foam against internal acoustic leakage | Multi-core SoC/DSP; total system $1\text{–}5\ \mathrm{W}$, continuous passive cooling | Wake response $<200\text{–}300\ \mathrm{ms}$; voice call $<150\ \mathrm{ms}$ | Far-field false-wake rate (e.g., $\le 0.05\text{–}0.1\ \mathrm{h}^{-1}$), EMC |

| Conference video bar & ceiling array | 4–16 mic linear/planar array (TDM/Dante/USB UAC) | Wall-mounted half-space or ceiling rigid baffle; $5\text{–}8\ \mathrm{m}$ strongly reverberant pickup | Mid-to-high-end DSP/SoC + NPU; total system $5\text{–}25\ \mathrm{W}$, passive/fan cooling | Uplink DSP $20\text{–}40\ \mathrm{ms}$; end-to-end $<150\ \mathrm{ms}$ | Microsoft Teams Rooms (G.122 $\mathrm{TCL}_w$, ETSI TS 103 224 / 3QUEST), Zoom Rooms |

| Smart automotive cabin | 4–16+ mic headliner & headrest distributed array (A²B synchronous bus, zero relative SRO) | Tight cabin strong reflections, $65\text{–}80\ \mathrm{dB\ SPL}$ road/wind noise, $-40\text{ to }+85\,^\circ\mathrm{C}$ wide temperature range | Automotive-grade DSP / cockpit SoC; audio subsystem $2\text{–}8\ \mathrm{W}$ | ICC $\Delta_{\mathrm{Rx}} < 15\ \mathrm{ms}$ (production typically $4\text{–}10\ \mathrm{ms}$); hands-free per P.1110/P.1120 | ITU-T P.1100–P.1150, automotive silicon AEC-Q100 |

- **Aligning with the ITU-T P.1100–P.1150 automotive speech standards family**: Cabin audio cannot be summarized by a single number; project scoping must first map each feature to its governing standard clause. Hands-free cellular telephony to external networks maps by transmission bandwidth to **ITU-T P.1100** (narrowband, $300\text{–}3400\ \mathrm{Hz}$), **P.1110** (wideband, $100\text{–}7000\ \mathrm{Hz}$), and **P.1120** (super-wideband and fullband), focusing on double-talk clipping, send delay, echo attenuation, and speech quality under road noise; subsystem, digital module, and short-range wireless link verification follows **P.1130**.

Post-crash emergency calling (eCall) is governed by **P.1140**, which mandates preserving a baseline intelligibility floor for Public Safety Answering Points under extreme cabin acoustic transients such as airbag deployment or shattered windows; meanwhile, **In-Car Communication (ICC)**—real-time reinforcement of front-row speech to rear-row passengers—is governed specifically by **P.1150**, centering on closed-loop howling stability margin, listening effort, spatial localization preservation, and strict reinforcement delay ceilings.

locator_hits_first5.text: 基于式(13-24)的相干漂移机理，学术与工程界形成了两条代表性盲 SRO 估计路线：其一是**加权平均相干漂移（WACD）及其动态在线版本 DWACD**（Gburrek、Schmalenstroeer 与 Haeb-Umbach，ICASSP 2022），通过对 $P_k[\ell]$ 做跨频加权相位斜率回归或逆离散傅里叶变换寻峰估计 $\hat\varepsilon$，并配合语音活动门控动态刷新参考段以跟踪温漂与说话人切换；其二是**双互相关相位变换处理器（DXCP-PhaT）**（Chinaev、Thüne 与 Enzner，*IEEE/ACM TASLP* vol. 29，第 1881～1896 页，2021），通过在 STFT 域构造经相位变换白化的二阶互相关量，恢复漂移互谱的遍历性，在强混响与大间距节点下同时实现盲 SRO 与残余时间偏移（STO）的稳健在线估计，从而与 §13.12 的 SRO 感知 DANSE（Didier 等，*IEEE OJSP* 2023）组成闭环。会议任务还应与 SRO 算法原实验分开核对：CHiME-5/6/7/8 的设备拓扑与同步、分离、识别协议随任务变化，不能将挑战赛名本身当作 DWACD/DXCP-PhaT 与分布式波束、GSS 联合运行收益的证据。[NOTSOFAR-1（Vinnikov等，Interspeech 2024，§2）](https://www.isca-archive.org/interspeech_2024/vinnikov24_interspeech.pdf)原任务为单设备单通道/多通道远场识别，刻意避开多设备复杂性；可用它研究相应会议前端，但原基准不是异步多设备 SRO 评测。

- 盲 SRO 原研究与远场会议基准：Gburrek, T.、Schmalenstroeer, J. 与 Haeb-Umbach, R.，ICASSP 2022（WACD/DWACD）；Chinaev, A.、Thüne, P. 与 Enzner, G.，*IEEE/ACM TASLP* 29, 1881–1896, 2021（DXCP-PhaT）；以及 CHiME-5/6/7/8（Barker 等 2018；Watanabe 等 2020；Cornell 等 2023/2024）与 NOTSOFAR-1（Vinnikov 等，Interspeech 2024）远场会议基准；其中 NOTSOFAR-1 原任务为单设备，不能统称为多设备异步评测。

Building on the coherence-drift mechanism in Eq. (13-24), two flagship blind SRO estimation families have emerged across academia and industry: first, **Weighted Average Coherence Drift (WACD) and its online dynamic variant DWACD** (Gburrek, Schmalenstroeer, & Haeb-Umbach, ICASSP 2022), which estimates $\hat\varepsilon$ via cross-frequency weighted phase-slope regression or inverse-DFT peak search on $P_k[\ell]$ paired with VAD-gated dynamic reference refreshes to track thermal crystal drift and talker switches; and second, the **Double Cross-Correlation Processor with Phase Transform (DXCP-PhaT)** (Chinaev, Thüne, & Enzner, *IEEE/ACM TASLP* vol. 29, pp. 1881–1896, 2021), which constructs a phase-transform-whitened second-order cross-correlation in the STFT domain to restore ergodicity of drifting cross-spectra, achieving robust online blind SRO and residual sampling time offset (STO) estimation even under strong reverberation and wide inter-node spacing—closing the loop with §13.12's SRO-aware DANSE (Didier et al., *IEEE OJSP* 2023). Meeting benchmarks need a separate task-level check. CHiME-5/6/7/8 differ in device topology and synchronization, separation, and recognition protocols; a challenge name alone does not establish a joint DWACD/DXCP-PhaT, distributed-beamforming, and GSS result. [NOTSOFAR-1 (Vinnikov et al., Interspeech 2024, §2)](https://www.isca-archive.org/interspeech_2024/vinnikov24_interspeech.pdf) defines single-device single-/multi-channel far-field recognition tasks, deliberately avoiding multi-device complexity. It supports study of those meeting front-ends, but its original task is not an asynchronous multi-device SRO benchmark.

- Blind SRO research and far-field meeting benchmarks: Gburrek, T., Schmalenstroeer, J., & Haeb-Umbach, R., ICASSP 2022 (WACD/DWACD); Chinaev, A., Thüne, P., & Enzner, G., *IEEE/ACM TASLP* 29, 1881–1896, 2021 (DXCP-PhaT); and the CHiME-5/6/7/8 (Barker et al. 2018; Watanabe et al. 2020; Cornell et al. 2023/2024) and NOTSOFAR-1 (Vinnikov et al., Interspeech 2024) far-field meeting benchmarks; NOTSOFAR-1 is originally a single-device task rather than an asynchronous multi-device evaluation.

当工程团队接到“开发一套支持重叠抢话的远场多人会议纪要系统”任务时，架构评审往往集中在两条技术路线的取舍上：一条是在 CHiME-6 / CHiME-7 / CHiME-8 DASR 及真实办公会议基准 **NOTSOFAR-1**（[Vinnikov 等，Interspeech 2024](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1788)）等远场多通道评测中经受长期检验的**模块化级联架构**（多通道 TS-VAD 日志 $\to$ WPE 去混响 + GSS 空间掩码波束形成 $\to$ 单人语音识别大模型 ASR）；另一条是近年快速崛起的**端到端或条件化大模型联合架构**，代表方案包括序列化输出训练（Serialized Output Training，SOT，[Kanda 等，Interspeech 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.12687)）与日志条件化 Whisper（Diarization-Conditioned Whisper，DiCoW，[Polok 等，*Computer Speech & Language* Vol. 95, 2026](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csl.2025.101841)）。

5. **远场视听融合、会议基准与多说话人联合转写**：Ephrat, A., et al. (2018), *Looking to Listen at the Cocktail Party*, ACM SIGGRAPH 2018（[arXiv:1804.03619](https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.03619)）；Afouras, T., Chung, J. (2023), *AV-SepFormer: Cross-Attention SepFormer for Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction*, ICASSP 2023（[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICASSP49357.2023.10094306)）；ITU-R Recommendation BT.1359-1 (1998), *Relative Timing of Sound and Vision for Broadcasting*；Kanda, N., et al. (2020), *Serialized Output Training for End-to-End Overlapped Speech Recognition*, Interspeech 2020（[arXiv:2003.12687](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.12687)）；von Neumann, T., Boeddeker, C., Delcroix, M., & Haeb-Umbach, R. (2024), *NOTSOFAR-1 Challenge: New Datasets, Baseline, and Tasks for Distant Meeting Transcription*, Interspeech 2024（[DOI](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1788)）；Polok, A., et al. When an engineering team is tasked with building a far-field multi-party meeting transcription system capable of handling overlapping cross-talk, architecture reviews invariably center on choosing between two technical paradigms: on one side stands the well-established **modular cascaded pipeline** proven across CHiME-6 / CHiME-7 / CHiME-8 DASR and real office-meeting benchmarks such as **NOTSOFAR-1** ([Vinnikov et al., Interspeech 2024](https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1788)) (multi-channel TS-VAD diarization $\to$ WPE dereverberation + GSS spatial-mask beamforming $\to$ single-speaker large ASR model); on the other side stand rapidly advancing **end-to-end or conditioned foundation-model joint architectures**, epitomized by Serialized Output Training (SOT, [Kanda et al., Interspeech 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.12687)) and Diarization-Conditioned Whisper (DiCoW, [Polok et al., *Computer Speech & Language*, Vol. 95, 2026](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csl.2025.101841)).

5. **Far-field audio–visual fusion, meeting benchmarks, and joint multi-speaker transcription**: Ephrat, A., et al. locator_hits_first5.text: 近年目标提取正沿着**空间区域可编程、语义提示与免声纹池化**三个方向持续演进：在空间与听觉交互侧，**Cone of Silence**（[Jenrungrot 等，NeurIPS 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.06007)）以二分角窗逐层锁定任意角度声源，**Semantic Hearing**（[Veluri 等，ACM UIST 2023](https://doi.org/10.1145/3586183.3606779)）在约 $6.6\ \mathrm{ms}$ 低延迟双耳因果架构上保留 ITD/ILD 线索实现按语义类别提取，**ReZero**（[Gu 与 Luo，*IEEE/ACM TASLP* 2024](https://doi.org/10.1109/TASLP.2024.3393713)）支持按自定义三维空间区域灵活提取目标声场，而 **SpatialNet**（[Quan 与 Li，*IEEE/ACM TASLP* 2024](https://doi.org/10.1109/TASLP.2024.3357036)）以窄带与跨带交替的多通道空间变换器显著强化了多麦空间线索建模；在声纹条件侧，**USEF-TSE**（[Zeng 与 Li，*IEEE TASLP* 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.02615)）直接用帧级交叉注意力对齐混合谱与注册语音、绕开定长说话人嵌入池化瓶颈，个性化分带循环网络（pBSRNN）则在连续流式目标提取中兼顾低算力与高音质。
#### 锚点手算算例 15-2：10 cm 桌面线阵对 2 cm 微型线阵的距离气泡复算
- 菲涅耳边界骤缩 25 倍至 $r_F = 2 \times 0.04^2 / 0.10 = 0.032\ \mathrm{m}$（仅 $3.2\ \mathrm{cm}$，远小于 $r_1 = 0.40\ \mathrm{m}$），此时 $0.40\ \mathrm{m}$ 说话人对该微型阵列而言早已属于远场。

- **子图 (a) 正横径向功率响应（$3430\ \mathrm{Hz}$）**：横轴为声源径向距离 $r \in [0.15, 5.0]\ \mathrm{m}$，纵轴为功率增益（dB）。红色虚线（传统远场 DSB）在 $r \gtrsim 0.5\ \mathrm{m}$ 区间近乎水平（$0\ \mathrm{dB}$），仅在极近场 $r = 0.15\ \mathrm{m}$ 处因球面波曲率失配略跌至 $-3.86\ \mathrm{dB}$，对 $4.0\ \mathrm{m}$ 同向干扰毫无抑制能力；蓝色实线（$d = 10\ \mathrm{cm}$ 距离气泡）在 $r_1 = 0.40\ \mathrm{m}$ 绿色点线处精确穿过 $0\ \mathrm{dB}$，随后随距离单调滚降，在 $r_2 = 4.00\ \mathrm{m}$ 紫色点线处压低至 $-19.65\ \mathrm{dB}$；橙色点划线（$d = 2\ \mathrm{cm}$ 正则气泡，$\delta = 5\times 10^{-4}$）则因孔径不足同时丢失近场增益与远场抑制斜率。

- **子图 (b) 阵元间距与白噪声增益塌缩**：横轴为相邻阵元间距 $d$（cm），纵轴为无正则白噪声增益 $\mathrm{WNG}$（dB）。蓝色圆点实线直观呈现按 $d^4$ 变化的陡峭滚降，绿色虚线与红色点划线分别标出 $d = 10\ \mathrm{cm}$（$-4.21\ \mathrm{dB}$ 可用工作区）与 $d = 2\ \mathrm{cm}$（$-31.82\ \mathrm{dB}$ 底噪放大禁区）。

Recent target extraction research has progressed along three complementary axes—**programmable spatial zones, semantic prompting, and embedding-free conditioning**: on the spatial and binaural front, **Cone of Silence** ([Jenrungrot et al., NeurIPS 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.06007)) isolates sources via binary-search angular windowing, **Semantic Hearing** ([Veluri et al., ACM UIST 2023](https://doi.org/10.1145/3586183.3606779)) achieves $\sim 6.6\ \mathrm{ms}$ causal binaural semantic sound extraction while preserving ITD/ILD cues, **ReZero** ([Gu & Luo, *IEEE/ACM TASLP* 2024](https://doi.org/10.1109/TASLP.2024.3393713)) enables region-customizable 3D spatial zone extraction, and **SpatialNet** ([Quan & Li, *IEEE/ACM TASLP* 2024](https://doi.org/10.1109/TASLP.2024.3357036)) interleaves narrow-band and cross-band multi-channel spatial attention for strong multi-microphone cue modeling; on the speaker-conditioning front, **USEF-TSE** ([Zeng & Li, *IEEE TASLP* 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.02615)) replaces pooled fixed-length embeddings with frame-level cross-attention directly between mixture and enrollment spectra, while personalized band-split RNNs (pBSRNN) deliver low-complexity continuous streaming extraction.
#### Worked Example 15-2: Distance-Bubble Calculation Comparing a 10 cm Desktop ULA Against a 2 cm Miniature ULA

- The Fresnel boundary shrinks 25-fold to $r_F = 2 \times 0.04^2 / 0.10 = 0.032\ \mathrm{m}$ (just $3.2\ \mathrm{cm}$, far below $r_1 = 0.40\ \mathrm{m}$); to this miniature array, a talker at $0.40\ \mathrm{m}$ is already in the far field.

- **Subplot (a) Broadside radial power response ($3430\ \mathrm{Hz}$)**: Horizontal axis shows source radial range $r \in [0.15, 5.0]\ \mathrm{m}$; vertical axis shows power gain (dB). The dashed red line (conventional far-field DSB) stays nearly flat ($0\ \mathrm{dB}$) across $r \gtrsim 0.5\ \mathrm{m}$—dipping only slightly to $-3.86\ \mathrm{dB}$ in the extreme near field at $r = 0.15\ \mathrm{m}$ due to spherical-wave curvature mismatch—with zero suppression of the $4.0\ \mathrm{m}$ co-directional interferer; the solid blue curve ($d = 10\ \mathrm{cm}$ distance bubble) crosses $0\ \mathrm{dB}$ precisely at the dotted green target line $r_1 = 0.40\ \mathrm{m}$ and rolls off monotonically with range to $-19.65\ \mathrm{dB}$ at the dotted purple interferer line $r_2 = 4.00\ \mathrm{m}$; the dash-dotted orange curve ($d = 2\ \mathrm{cm}$ regularized bubble, $\delta = 5\times 10^{-4}$) loses both near-field gain and far-field roll-off slope due to insufficient aperture.

- **Subplot (b) Inter-element spacing vs. WNG collapse**: Horizontal axis shows adjacent sensor spacing $d$ (cm); vertical axis shows unregularized white noise gain $\mathrm{WNG}$ (dB). The solid blue curve with circles illustrates the steep $d^4$ roll-off, with vertical dashed green and dash-dotted red lines marking $d = 10\ \mathrm{cm}$ ($-4.21\ \mathrm{dB}$ viable operating zone) and $d = 2\ \mathrm{cm}$ ($-31.82\ \mathrm{dB}$ noise-amplification forbidden zone).
